  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

  1. Online assessment or practical task

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
jobs.description:
Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

jobs.title: Surveyor I
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

Notice

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

Other

Freelance · Teilzeit · Festanstellung möglich

Du bist die kreative Kraft hinter unseren Videos. Videograf, Darsteller und Editor sind bereits an Bord. Du übernimmst die Führung und die Verantwortung für das Ergebnis.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Konzept & Skripte: Du entwickelst Ad-Konzepte und schreibst die Skripte für unsere Drehtage - Hooks, Storylines und Formate, die im Feed hängen bleiben.

  • Drehtage leiten: 2x im Monat leitest du die Drehtage in Hamburg. Du führst Regie, coachst die Darsteller und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Ablauf.

  • Editing-Kommunikation: Du bist die Schnittstelle zu unserem Editor, gibst klares Feedback und steuerst die Schnittfreigaben.

  • Ergebnis sichern: Du verantwortest, dass die fertigen Videos qualitativ und kreativ unseren Ansprüchen entsprechen und rechtzeitig live gehen können.

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As a product marketer at Vanta, you’ll help bring this vision to life by defining the new category of trust management, shaping Vanta’s positioning and differentiators externally, and influencing our product and business roadmap. We sit at the intersection of Marketing & Demand Generation, Sales, Product, and Customer Success and revel in connecting all of these teams to drive the business forward. Research, analysis, curiosity, storytelling, and project management are just a few of the attributes of our team – in addition to being open, empathetic, and genuinely nice people.

As the EMEA Product Marketing lead, you will be responsible for bringing Vanta’s story to the EMEA audience to help us drive sustainable growth in the market. You’ll craft compelling messaging that’s tailored to the region, based on insights from buyer and market research. You’ll lead product launches to help amplify Vanta’s presence in the region, and partner closely with our product management team to identify growth opportunities for us to continue building our product. Finally, you’ll partner closely with our GTM organisation to expand Vanta’s footprint and accelerate our growth.

What you’ll do as a Product Marketing Lead at Vanta:

  • Define and manage go-to-market (GTM) strategy for Vanta’s business in EMEA tailored to the unique opportunities across the EMEA region

  • Develop tailored messaging and positioning for EMEA based on market research and customer insights

  • Partner with our EMEA growth team on the development and execution of targeted marketing campaigns, including tailored messaging and content that effectively engage local audiences and drive business objectives

  • Plan and execute large product launches (including GTM enablement of sales and customer success), report back on performance, and optimize our launch processes for scale

  • Author compelling content for each stage of the customer journey, from blog posts to sales collateral

  • Talk regularly to Vanta’s customers, analyze your own data, and understand our competitive landscape to help shape the product strategy and roadmap and inform Vanta’s overall EMEA marketing strategy

  • Partner closely with the EMEA team at Vanta – including demand gen, sales, customer success, and product—to help achieve our objectives in the market

  • Refine Vanta’s pricing and packaging based on deep insights around the market, our product value, and customer needs in partnership with finance, operations, product, sales, and customer success

  • Be a strong customer champion, creative marketer, and problem solver

How to be successful in this role:

  • Have 7+ years of Product Marketing experience, with an emphasis on B2B SaaS

  • Have a deep empathy for users and an ability to adapt communication to best reach, engage and differentiate Vanta to your audience

  • Enjoy working with data and pairing those quantitative conclusions with the qualitative conversations you have with users

  • Find delight in understanding how things work and then explaining your newfound knowledge to others

  • Must be based on London or Dublin, this role will be hybrid in-office

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

  • Pension matching

  • 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

  • 8 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

#LI-hybrid

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

Referral Instructions

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

The Partner BDM is where the global partnership strategy meets the market, and you own the partner pipeline and revenue target for your region — you are the person who drives the strategy to meet and exceed that number. Every relationship, every lead, every partner conversation in your territory goes through you. You execute all three partnership pillars locally — integration depth, reseller acquisition, and long tail activation — and you feed the national programs run by Isabel and the Director of Reseller Partnerships with the contacts, intelligence, and HubSpot discipline that makes those programs possible.

This role also carries a global partner management component. In addition to your regional territory, you will be assigned one or two global partner accounts — relationships that span multiple BDM regions and require a consistent strategic, commercial presence above the regional level. You will manage these accounts directly, briefing with the Global Partner Marketing Manager before any senior contact touchpoint and feeding back the account intelligence that informs RPG's global partner strategy.

The BDM is not a lone hunter. You are supported by intelligence briefs from the Director of Partnership Strategy, onboarding infrastructure from the Partner Operation and Enablement Manager, co-sell support from the Director of Channel Growth Reseller, and global account context from the Global Partner Marketing Manager. The discipline of using those inputs — requesting briefs before first calls, completing HubSpot fields that trigger Isabel's onboarding, registering every lead in Introw on the day — is what makes the whole system work.

Your Role

Pipeline and revenue ownership — your region

  • Own the partner pipeline and revenue target for your region — you are the person who drives the strategy to meet and exceed this number, not just a contributor to it

  • Build and maintain a consistent bottoms-up pipeline plan, built up against your region's targets and TAM — showing exactly how your book of business adds up to your target, by partner type and by deal stage

  • Forecast monthly, ahead of the full-team KPR review — reforecasting pipeline and revenue coverage against target, reconciling to the latest refreshed regional targets/TAM where these have moved, so gaps are visible early and plans can be adjusted before target dates, not after

  • Request a partner intelligence brief from the Director Channel Growth - Integration before every first partner outreach — no first conversation without a brief

  • Complete the 4 mandatory HubSpot fields (deal stage, partner fields, agreement file, partnership type) before advancing any deal past the signed stage — this triggers Isabel's onboarding program

  • Register every qualified lead in Introw on the day it is received, tagged by source type (integration referral / reseller / consultant / reactivated dormant)

Global Partner Account Management

  • Own one or two assigned global partner accounts — relationships where the partner operates across multiple BDM territories and requires consistent commercial management above the regional level

  • Build the regional strategy for each assigned global account that generates pipeline — not just relationship maintenance; you are responsible for identifying where the pipeline comes from in your territory and driving it

  • Coordinate with Global Partner Marketing Manager before any senior touchpoint at a global partner account — global commercial context will be provided; you provide the regional relationship intelligence

  • Maintain the account relationship at the appropriate contact levels (sales, CS, KAM, implementation) — applying the multi-level engagement model from the Partner Activation Playbook

  • Feed the Head of Global Partnerships and the Global Partner Marketing Manager with global account intelligence after every significant touchpoint — health signals, competitive intelligence, co-marketing opportunities, and any escalation requirements

  • Support the coordination of co-marketing and QBR activity with the global partner where it involves your region

Long Tail Activation — Regional subset

  • Own your regional subset of the 272 dormant signed partners — the Director Channel Growth - Reseller & Consultant,provides the segmented list, you own the outreach

  • Execute the tiered re-engagement approach: Tier 1 (60–90 days dormant) with a personalized message within the first week of assignment; Tier 2 with re-qualification before any effort; Tier 3 with a single attempt then escalation to Isabel to archive

  • Report progress on your regional dormant subset to Isabel weekly during the H2 activation sprint

Market intelligence and HubSpot discipline

  • Surface partner contacts and market intelligence to the Reseller PM in the bi-weekly regional intel exchange — which reseller types are gaining traction, which are declining, what competitive signals are emerging

  • Flag any integration partner conversation where an all-in-one competitive angle appears — the Strategy Manager updates the competitive library with field intelligence

  • Maintain HubSpot contact and deal records at the expected quality standard — the data in HubSpot is what the whole team uses to run the business; poor data quality breaks Isabel's onboarding, Isabel's dormancy tracking, and Introw attribution simultaneously

  • Participate in the monthly full-team KPR review — presenting your regional lead pipeline and flagging any structural blockers

Your Profile

  • 2+ years in a B2B business development, partnerships, or commercial account management role — ideally in SaaS, hospitality technology, or a related field

  • Demonstrates advanced proficiency in German (C2 level), with excellent command of both

  • Track record of building relationships and generating pipeline from scratch in a defined territory — not managing inbound, but generating outbound

  • Comfortable operating across multiple partner types and conversation styles in a single week — integration partnership conversations require a different approach than reseller qualification

  • HubSpot or CRM discipline — this is a non-negotiable requirement; the quality of your data determines the quality of the team's output

  • Based in the target territory — regional credibility and proximity to local partners is part of the role

Nice to Have

  • Existing network in the hotel technology ecosystem (PMS, channel manager, consultants, or revenue management) in the relevant territory

  • Experience managing global or multi-territory accounts in addition to a local territory portfolio

  • Familiarity with Introw, PartnerStack, Reditus, or similar partner and commission tracking platforms

  • Revenue management or hospitality operations background — understanding how an independent hotel owner thinks is a genuine advantage in partner conversations

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agents (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
About this role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Agentic SOC team. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. This team's mission is to build LLM-powered agents that augment our security analysts, taking on repetitive investigation and triage work so humans can focus on the judgment-heavy parts of the job.

You will work in a small, full-stack team of 2 to 3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets, and who is excited about shipping agents into a real production SOC where correctness, latency, and cost all matter.

In this role

  • Own features end-to-end as Feature Lead: scope the problem, coordinate work within your team, make day-to-day technical decisions, and ship it to production. You are trusted to take a high-level goal and turn it into a plan without close supervision.

  • Lead the design and delivery of LLM agents that plug into our SOC workflows, including tool design, prompt and context engineering, evals, and guardrails. Make sound tradeoffs on accuracy, cost, latency, and how much autonomy to give the agent versus keeping a human in the loop.

  • Drive technical design discussions in your stream and, where the work calls for it, influence architecture and standards beyond it. Set the bar for code quality, testing, and documentation on your team.

  • Ground engineering decisions in outcomes. Push back when the "why" is unclear, propose simpler or faster paths to the business result, and stay close to the security analysts and customers your agents are meant to serve.

  • Mentor engineers on your team and across the stream through pairing, code review, and design feedback. Act as a multiplier, not just a strong individual contributor.

  • Participate in hiring: interview candidates, help shape the bar, and support onboarding.

  • Contribute to a psychologically safe and outcome-oriented team culture. Lead by example in incidents and high-pressure moments.

  • The role is remote in the Netherlands or in Berlin, with a commitment to travel to the office (The Hague or Berlin) twice per week.

What you will need

  • 5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. You are comfortable working across backend and frontend layers and you pick up new technologies independently.

  • Depth in at least one technical area and broad competence across the stack. You have designed and shipped systems where performance, security, reliability, and maintainability all mattered, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made.

  • Experience with strongly typed languages (Typescript, Java, dotnet, PHP, or similar). We operate in Go and React, and we back ourselves to get a seasoned engineer with strongly typed experience up to speed in our stack quickly.

  • Hands-on experience building LLM agents, with evidence they were useful. You have built and shipped at least one non-trivial LLM-powered agent or agentic workflow, in production or as a side project with real users. You can speak concretely about the design choices you made around tool use, context and state, evals, failure handling, autonomy, cost, and latency and, just as importantly, what the agent changed for the people using it.

  • Comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow.

  • A track record of raising the level of engineers around you through mentoring, code review, and design feedback.

  • Strong communication skills. You can translate technical tradeoffs for engineers, product managers, and leadership, and you write designs and decisions in a way others can build on.

  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and secure development principles to build safe, trusted systems.

  • Fluency in English is a must.

What we offer

  • Work on genuinely hard problems in a complex domain: XDR, security data at scale, and tooling that empowers security analysts to protect hundreds of customers across Europe.

  • Real ownership in a small, autonomous team where every engineer is close to the work, close to the decision-making, and close to the impact.

  • A deliberate bet on AI-augmented engineering and AI-augmented security operations: we are building toward small teams that punch well above their weight through smart AI adoption, and you will be part of shaping how that works in practice for both how we build and how our SOC operates.

  • Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure.

  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.

  • Join a young and thriving scale-up which is on its way to becoming the category leader in Europe.

  • We are a great place to work, filled with people who enjoy working together.

About Eye Security

 

Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform.

 

Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

 

We are a rapidly growing company and believe in investing in our people. If you're a highly motivated and results-oriented engineer with a passion for building secure, scalable technologies, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Doctorant.e: Quantification des pesticides dans les dépôts atmosphériques : Origine et Variabilité  CDD 36 mois à IMT Nord Europe
jobs.description:
Unité : CERI EE (IMT NE) et Institut de Chimie et Procédés pour l'Energie l'Environnement et la Santé (ICPEES, UMR 7515 CNRS, Université de Strasbourg)

Responsable hiérarchique : Nadine Locoge (IMT NE)

Responsable fonctionnel : Dr. Aude Bourin (IMT NE), Prof. Alexandre Tomas (IMT NE), et Prof. Maurice Millet (Université de Strasbourg)

Catégorie :

Nature de l’emploi : Doctorat

Lieu de travail : Strasbourg / Douai

Contexte :

Le doctorat s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une collaboration scientifique entre le Centre d’Enseignement, Recherche et Innovation Energie Environnement (CERI EE) d’IMT Nord Europe et l’UMR 7515 CNRS-UNISTRA : ICPEES (Institut de Chimie et Procédés pour l’Energie, l’Environnement et la Santé) dont l’objectif est de renseigner l’influence des pluies sur les dépôts de pesticides au niveau national, en plus des données existantes dans l’air ambiant.

L’IMT Nord Europe est une école sous tutelle du ministère de l’économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique. IMT Nord Europe est née en 2017 de la fusion de Télécom Lille et de l’École des Mines de Douai. Elle compte aujourd’hui parmi les plus Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs au Nord de Paris avec plus 2200 élèves, dont un quart d’apprentis, plus de 600 diplômés par an et un réseau de 15 000 diplômés. Elle fait partie de l’Institut Mines Télécom, premier groupe public de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France, et est partenaire de l’université de Lille.

IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital.

Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20 000 m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les trois domaines « Systèmes Numériques », « Energie Environnement » et « Matériaux et Procédés ».

Le CERI EE d’IMT Nord Europe développe des activités au cœur des transitions énergétiques et environnementales. Sa recherche est orientée vers les sciences de l'atmosphère, la qualité des environnements intérieurs et les enjeux de l’efficacité énergétique et de la décarbonation. La candidate/le candidat intégrera l’un des 3 axes thématiques du CERI EE, l’axe OSPA (Observations, Sources et Processus physico-chimiques Atmosphériques).

Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École : www.imt-nord-europe.fr et celui du CERI EE https://recherche.imt-nord-europe.fr/energie-environnement-ceri

L’ICPEES (Institut de Chimie et Procédés pour l'Energie, l'Environnement et la Santé, UMR 7515 du CNRS et de l’Université de Strasbourg) a été créé en janvier 2013 lorsque deux laboratoires, le Laboratoire des matériaux, surfaces et procédés pour la catalyse (LMSPC) et le Laboratoire d'ingénierie des polymères pour les hautes technologies (LIPHT), décident de fusionner. Lors de la fusion, les trois équipes du LIPHT et les sept équipes du LMSPC ont été structurées en trois départements de recherche : catalyse et matériaux, chimie moléculaire et analytique, ingénierie des polymères.

La transversalité des compétences présentes au sein de l’Institut permet de traiter des problématiques globales allant de la synthèse des molécules à l’élaboration de l’objet final pour des applications liées à l'Energie, l'Environnement ou la Santé. L’implication forte des équipes de l’unité dans les recherches fondamentales avec une visée applicative a permis au laboratoire de se positionner sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur et d’acquérir une renommée internationale. Les collaborations académiques tant nationales qu’internationales ont contribué aussi aux développements de nouveaux axes de recherche inexploités à l’heure actuelle. Les développements avals des recherches menées au sein de l’unité ont également permis de tisser de nombreuses collaborations avec le monde socio-économique en apportant des solutions concrètes aux différentes demandes sociétales et en développant de nouveaux procédés en adéquation avec les nouvelles législations. 

Les activités de recherche au sein de l’unité ne peuvent être menées d’une manière sereine, sans l’appui fort des pôles de soutien à la recherche, qui ont permis de fluidifier les demandes techniques et administratives. L’excellente cohésion entre ces pôles et les équipes de recherche a contribué également à mieux anticiper des problèmes éventuels et à d’optimiser le fonctionnement quotidien au sein de l’unité. En 2020, la direction de l’ICPEES a organisé le service commun technique en 3 pôles : le Pôle Caractérisation, le Pôle Ingénierie et Développement et le Pôle Chimie.

Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’ICPEES :

https://icpees.unistra.fr

Missions :

Le doctorant aura pour mission d’évaluer la dynamique des dépôts atmosphériques de pesticides à différentes échelles spatiales et temporelles en collaboration avec l’observatoire MERA (https://www.lcsqa.org/fr/le-dispositif-mera) et les AASQA (https://www.atmo-france.org/) sur le territoire national. Dans un premier temps, il devra adapter les méthodes d’analyse de pesticides existantes en GC/MSMS et LC/MSMS dans l’équipe « CAMATES (Chimie Analytique MATériaux, Environnement Santé) » de l’ICPEES (UMR 7515 CNRS-UNISTRA), en particulier intégrer les pesticides de la liste prioritaire de l’ANSES[1] et ceux du dispositif Pesticides coordonné par le LCSQA[2] (https://www.lcsqa.org/fr/le-dispositif-pesticides). Il aura également pour mission de déterminer la méthode technique d’extraction de ces molécules et de quantifier l’effet de matrice/interférences potentiels que peuvent générer les eaux pluviales et les dépôts secs. Pour cela, il disposera d’échantillons réels de dépôts totaux (humides et secs) qu’il dopera avec des molécules non présentes dans les échantillons et des étalons marqués.

Il aura ensuite la tâche d’analyser les échantillons de dépôts atmosphériques collectés de manière hebdomadaire pendant 1 an sur plusieurs sites d’étude et également de quantifier si la réfrigération des échantillons pendant leur stockage dans le préleveur est indispensable.

Enfin, il aura à interpréter et analyser les résultats en termes d’occurrence, de variabilité spatiale et temporelle (influence de l’activité agricole), de relation avec les conditions météorologiques (trajectoire des masses d’air) et de corrélation avec d’autres polluants atmosphériques ou des mesures de pesticides dans l’air ambiant réalisées en parallèle par les AASQA.

 

Activités :

  1.       Instrumentation pour les dépôts atmosphériques et développements analytiques (t0 – t6) -- à Douai puis Strasbourg

  •            effectuer des essais techniques pour vérifier la conformité des appareils de collecte des dépôts atmosphériques (Douai)

  •            modification de méthodes existantes en GC/MSMS et LC/MSMS (retraits/ajouts de molécules),

  •            développement MSMS des nouvelles molécules,

  •            validation de la méthode (limites de détection et de quantification, répétabilité, reproductibilité,…)

  •            choix de la méthode de préparation des échantillons (LLE, SPE, SPME, …),

  •            évaluation des interférences et de l’effet de matrice par dopage avec des étalons deutérés et des molécules de pesticides non présentes dans les échantillons (screening de la présence/absence en amont)

2.       Analyse des échantillons collectés sur le terrain (t7 – t20) – à Strasbourg

  •            gestion hebdomadaire des échantillons : réception, extraction, analyses, conditionnement des flacons

  •            traitement des résultats obtenus d’analyses : prétraitement des données, intégration des chromatogrammes, identification des composés, quantification et validation des résultats avec contrôle qualité

3.       Interprétation des résultats acquis (t21 – t28) -- à Douai

4.       Rédaction de publications, du mémoire de thèse et valorisations à l’international (t21 – t36) – à Douai

 

Participations éventuelles aux activités d’enseignement en chimie analytique (TP en Licence pour l’Université de Strasbourg) (dans la limite de 64 heures par année scolaire).


[1] Agence Nationale de Sécurité Sanitaire de l’alimentation, de l’environnement et du travail

[2] Laboratoire Central de Surveillance de la Qualité de l’Air


Profil du candidat : (Prérequis/ Diplôme)

Un(e) candidat(e) titulaire d’un master en chimie analytique, avec des connaissances spécifiques en techniques expérimentales (LC-MS/MS, GC-MS/MS).

 

Savoir-être

Savoir-faire

Connaissances

Rigueur scientifique

Esprit d’équipe

Savoir communiquer sur ses activités en français et en anglais

Participer à la vie du laboratoire (aider/encadrer des stagiaires)

Participer à la maintenance des équipements analytiques

Développement de méthode d’analyse en chromatographie couplée à la spectrométrie de masse

Optimisation des paramètres de quantification de polluants en trace dans des matrices complexes

Chromatographie

Spectrométrie de masse

Préparation d’échantillons

Echantillonnage dans l’air

Traitement de données statistiques

Le poste est à pourvoir à compter de février 2027 pour une durée de 36 mois.

jobs.title: Ingénieur·e de recherche en identification d'état pour les systèmes temps réel réactifs – CDD 3 mois
jobs.description:
Présentation de Télécom SudParis :

Télécom SudParis est une grande école publique d'ingénieurs reconnue au meilleur niveau des sciences et technologies du numérique. La qualité de ses formations est basée sur l’excellence scientifique de son corps professoral et une pédagogie mettant l’accent sur les projets d’équipes, l’innovation de rupture et l’entreprenariat. Télécom SudParis compte 1 000 étudiantes et étudiants dont 700 élèves ingénieurs et environ de 150 doctorantes et doctorants. Télécom SudParis fait partie de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’école d’ingénieurs en France, et partage son campus avec Institut Mines-Télécom Business School. Télécom SudParis est co- fondatrice de l'Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris), Institut de Sciences et Technologies à vocation mondiale avec l’École polytechnique, l’ENSTA Paris, l’ENSAE Paris, l'ENPC et Télécom Paris. Vidéo présentation de Télécom SudParis

À propos de l'Institut Mines-Télécom :

L'Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un établissement public dédié à l'enseignement supérieur et la recherche pour l'innovation dans les domaines de l'ingénierie et du numérique. À l’écoute permanente du monde économique, l'IMT conjugue une forte légitimité académique et scientifique, une proximité avec les entreprises et un positionnement unique sur les transformations majeures au XXIe siècle : numériques, énergétiques, industrielles et éducatives siècle. Ses activités se déploient au sein des grandes écoles Mines et Télécom sous tutelle du ministre en charge de l’Industrie et des communications électroniques, de deux filiales et de partenaires associés ou sous convention. L'IMT est membre fondateur de l’Alliance Industrie du Futur. Il est doublement labellisé Carnot pour la qualité de sa recherche partenariale. Vidéo de présentation de l'Institut Mines-Télécom

Missions

  • Conduire des travaux de recherche fondamentale et appliquée en informatique sur l’identification d’état et la détection des conditions de compétition dans les systèmes temps réel.

  • Étudier et développer des approches visant à améliorer la fiabilité et les performances des systèmes de réseaux distribués.

  • Mobiliser des modèles formels temps réel, des méthodes d’identification d’état et des stratégies de détection des conditions de compétition.

  • Contribuer au développement de nouvelles méthodes d’analyse et de vérification des systèmes temps réel.

Activités

 1. Mener des travaux de recherche sur l’identification d’état et la détection des conditions de compétition dans les systèmes temps réel

  • Participer activement et régulièrement aux réunions de l’équipe de recherche.

  • Collaborer avec les membres de l’équipe à la conduite des travaux scientifiques.

  • Modéliser des systèmes de réseaux distribués à l’aide d’automates temporisés (Timed Automata) et de machines à états finis temporisées (Timed Finite State Machines).

  • Spécifier et vérifier des propriétés temporelles, notamment les conditions de compétition, à l’aide de solveurs et d’outils de vérification formelle tels qu’UPPAAL.

  • Mettre en œuvre et évaluer des méthodes existantes de génération de séquences d’identification d’état pour les automates temporisés et les machines à états finis temporisées, notamment les séquences de synchronisation (synchronizing sequences), de détermination de l’état initial (homing sequences) et de distinction (distinguishing sequences).

  • Exploiter des techniques telles que les arbres de successeurs et les méthodes d’abstraction pour dériver des séquences d’identification d’état.

  • Concevoir de nouvelles stratégies d’identification d’état et de détection des conditions de compétition.

  • Réaliser des expérimentations, analyser les résultats et évaluer les performances des méthodes développées.

 

2. Valoriser et diffuser les résultats de recherche

  • Rédiger des articles scientifiques et contribuer à leur publication dans des revues et conférences internationales.

  • Présenter les résultats des travaux lors de conférences, séminaires, colloques et autres manifestations scientifiques.

  • Participer aux échanges scientifiques et contribuer à la diffusion des connaissances au sein de la communauté de recherche.

 

3. Contribuer aux activités d’enseignement et d’encadrement

  • Participer à l’encadrement des étudiants dans le cadre de projets de recherche, de travaux pratiques ou de projets académiques.

  • Contribuer aux activités d’enseignement en lien avec les domaines scientifiques du projet.


Formation

  • Doctorat ou PhD depuis moins de 3 ans

Compétences, connaissances et expériences indispensables

  • Expertise scientifique : maîtriser l’analyse des systèmes temps réel réactifs et comprendre les liens entre les conditions de compétition et l’identification de l’état final.

  • Détection des conditions de compétition : maîtriser les concepts liés à la détection des conditions de compétition et à la théorie de la concurrence.

  • Vérification formelle : maîtriser les méthodes de vérification de la concurrence entre les entrées et les sorties dans les automates temporisés et les machines à états finis temporisées.

  • Identification d’état : maîtriser les concepts et les méthodes d’identification d’état, notamment les séquences de synchronisation et de distinction pour les automates temporisés et les machines à états finis temporisées.

  • Robustesse des séquences : analyser les conditions de robustesse des séquences d’identification d’état vis-à-vis des conditions de compétition.

  • Outils de vérification : utiliser des outils et solveurs de vérification formelle, notamment UPPAAL et Z3.

  • Programmation : mobiliser des compétences en programmation pour la mise en œuvre, l’expérimentation et l’évaluation des méthodes développées.

  • Langues : maîtriser l’anglais à l’écrit et à l’oral. La connaissance du français constitue un atout.

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables

  • Les systèmes de réseau distribué et de Cloud sont envisagés comme cas d’études

  • connaissance et expérience pertinente en matière de réseaux, de cloud et de systèmes distribués seraient un atout.

Capacités et aptitudes

  • Curiosité et autonomie en recherche

  • Travail en équipe et collaboration

  • Rédaction (scientifique) et communication orale

  • Créativité et esprit critique

  • Gestion du temps

Indications de rémunération:

  • Fourchette indicative de rémunération (hors bonus annuel variable): 33.700- 45.000 euros bruts annuels, selon le profil et l’expérience (charges salariales réduites en secteur public).

  • Catégorie et métier du poste (usage interne): II - R, Ingénieur de recherche et développement ou A (fonction publique)

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineering Consultant
jobs.description:
Nomios’ mission is to build a secure and connected future. Organisations across the globe depend on us to help secure and connect their digital infrastructures.

As part of our continued UK growth, we are expanding our Professional Services capability and seeking a Security Engineering Consultant to deliver specialist security engineering and operations consultancy across our customer base.

This is a hands-on technical role within the Security Operations domain, focused on helping customers improve and automate their SOC functions, tooling, and detection capabilities. You will work across a range of technologies and engagements, from SOAR and SIEM implementation through to vulnerability management, exposure management, and process automation.

Your role as Senior Security Engineering Consultant

The Security Engineering Consultant role sits within the Security Operations Team, working directly with the Nomios SOC Engineering team.

This is a senior, customer-facing Professional Services role within our Security Engineering function, focused on detection engineering and automation. You will lead the design and delivery of detection and response capabilities across SIEM, XDR and SOAR platforms. This includes building detection rules, developing automations, and creating operational playbooks that support effective SOC outcomes.

A key aspect of the role is ownership of the detection as code approach, ensuring detections and automations are developed, structured and delivered in a consistent and scalable way. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves.

HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD

GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a usable answer. This is done with agents: specialised AI components that each take on part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can’t just sound convincing. It has to be correct, and you need to be able to see which source it comes from. This isn’t a pilot: the platform is in production and used heavily every day.

As a senior, you build alongside the team, but you also keep the bigger picture in view. You know the different parts of the platform and how they affect one another. You help prioritise, spot obstacles early and make sure we’re heading in the right direction, both in how we work and technically. You look ahead: where could we go, and what do we need to know to get there? And you help medior colleagues grow by seeing exactly where they’re stuck, without taking the work off their hands.

  • You give direction to the agent architecture of GenIA-L: which specialised agents are needed and how they work together.

  • You break down legal processes and translate them into technical solutions. You decide how the components are best connected.

  • You make sure our knowledge packages and the pipelines behind them can scale and stay up to date. A knowledge package is an expert-reviewed set of commentary, case law, legislative history and practical guidance for each article of law.

  • You build the way we measure quality. Using evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability are genuinely improving. Not based on gut feeling, but on evidence.

  • You help prioritise the team’s work and flag technical or process risks early.

  • You explore new developments, test ideas in practice and turn them into proposals that make the product sharper or faster.

  • You coach medior engineers and work directly with editors and subject-matter experts.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You follow new AI developments closely, but you don’t just follow the herd: you stay critical and aren’t afraid to say so. You can break a complex problem down into smaller pieces and keep oversight of a system with many moving parts. You take ownership, show initiative when things aren’t yet clear and think from the customer’s problem. You enjoy helping others move forward without taking over. And you like working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like.

  • Extensive experience in software or ML engineering, around 5 years or more. Depth in recent projects counts for more than the number of years.

  • In-depth knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries.

  • You’ve built LLM applications and run them in production.

  • Solid experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or similar orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer setup (RAG) isn’t enough.

  • You’ve made the quality of LLM systems measurable with evaluation sets and observability, and can give concrete examples. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus.

  • Strong backend experience, including REST APIs and Postgres databases.

  • Experience with Kubernetes.

  • Experience in the legal, tax or another knowledge-intensive domain is a plus.

WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR

On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. What colleagues value most here: mutual trust, room to experiment, and a team that helps each other out when someone gets stuck.

  • A place where you have influence from day one: on the approach, the processes, and the direction.

  • Colleagues who deliberately chose Lefebvre Sdu over big tech jobs because here, they're building something that doesn't exist yet.

  • Base salary between €5,500 and €6,450 per month, based on a 36-hour week, since that's full-time for us. Plus a lot of extra allowances (see below).

  • A bonus tied to company performance: a fixed year-end bonus of 4% and profit sharing of up to 6%.

  • 23 vacation days and a personal choice budget of 12%, of which 8% is holiday pay and 4% is freely allocable. Want more vacation? Just buy it.

  • A bonus of up to 10% of your salary, based on company performance and individual performance.

  • A solid pension plan through PGB, including supplementary partner insurance.

  • Collective insurance plans.

  • A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometer or a public transport reimbursement, plus an attractive bike plan. For employees with a commute of less than 10 km or more than 60 km, we have an adjusted arrangement.

  • Two days a week in the office in The Hague, within walking distance of Voorburg station. The rest of the week, wherever you work best.

  • Room to grow: in your craft, in your role, in the organization.

Want to know more?

We’d love to tell you all about the team and the role. Send us your CV and you’ll hear from us within 5 working days. Any questions first? Message or call Nadine on 06 28556265.

A reference check and a VOG (certificate of good behaviour) are part of the selection process.

 The purpose of this Support Service is to provide technical support to the Engineering Services Section and the Test Facilities and Laboratories Section across multiple technical domains, ensuring the efficient operation, maintenance, and development of the Test Centre's facilities, infrastructure, and test capabilities. 

 

Please note, the successful candidate will be employed by ATG Europe (or one of its subsidiaries). Furthermore, upon selection, they will be subject to a general security screening performed by an external provider (further information will be provided at the interview stage). 

 

ATG is dedicated to diversity and inclusion and is an equal opportunity employer. Regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, handicap, or any other reason protected by relevant state or municipal legislation, we are pleased to consider all eligible candidates for employment. 

 

The successful candidate will be tasked with, but not limited to: 

  • Design, develop, and maintain Mechanical Ground Support Equipment (MGSE) to support testing activities within ESTEC laboratories and Test Centre facilities; 

  • Produce 3D CAD models, manufacturing drawings, and technical documentation suitable for fabrication and implementation; 

  • Perform structural and engineering analyses, including finite element modelling (FEM), to verify design compliance and performance; 

  • Prepare design justification documentation, including calculations, assumptions, analyses, and technical recommendations; 

  • Ensure MGSE designs comply with applicable technical requirements, quality standards, and ESA regulations; 

  • Provide engineering support during manufacturing, assembly, installation, and commissioning activities; 

  • Coordinate and execute verification activities, including inspections, proof load tests, acceptance testing, and related assessments; 

  • Manage the development, modification, and upgrade of test facilities in response to operational and engineering requirements; 

  • Gather and consolidate technical requirements from stakeholders and translate them into engineering solutions and technical specifications; 

  • Support procurement activities through the preparation of technical specifications, technical evaluations, and supplier coordination; 

  • Plan, supervise, and coordinate facility development activities throughout the project lifecycle; 

  • Liaise with internal teams, laboratory personnel, contractors, and suppliers to ensure successful project delivery; 

  • Monitor technical, quality, safety, and schedule compliance for design and facility development activities; 

  • Develop and maintain engineering documentation, including 3D models, electrical schematics, P&ID diagrams, reports, and configuration records; 

  • Support testing, audits, and acceptance activities related to engineered systems, equipment, and test facilities. 


Please ensure that your CV clearly explains how you meet the mandatory requirements. If it doesn’t align completely with the essential criteria, it could result in rejection. 

  • Master's degree or equivalent qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline; 

  • At least 4 years of proven experience in mechanical design and development of engineering systems, equipment, or test facilities; 

  • Experience with 3D CAD design tools, ideally 3DX (3DEXPERIENCE) or equivalent software; 

  • Experience performing structural analyses and finite element modelling (FEM), preferably using Nastran/Patran or similar tools; 

  • Ability to produce manufacturing drawings, technical specifications, and design justification documentation; 

  • Experience managing technical projects, facility developments, or engineering modifications involving multiple stakeholders; 

  • Knowledge of testing, verification, inspection, and acceptance processes for engineering hardware and facilities; 

  • Experience developing technical documentation, including engineering reports, schematics, and P&ID diagrams; 

  • Strong analytical, organisational, and communication skills; 

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken; 

  • Candidates must be eligible to work in the EU. 

 

Please submit your application in English via the apply button below. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.

jobs.description:
Role - (Senior) Key Account & Sales Manager (m/w/d) für gewerbliche und industrielle Batteriespeichersysteme (DACH)

Company - iwell Germany GmbH - Harmonizing Clean Energy

Standort - Düsseldorf

Über iwell

Bei iwell dreht sich alles um die Stärkung der Energiesicherheit. Wir helfen europäischen Unternehmen, energieunabhängiger zu werden. Angesichts wachsender Regulierung, extremer Preisvolatilität und zunehmender Netzengpässe müssen Unternehmen widerstandsfähig sein. Es ist Zeit, die Initiative zu ergreifen und vorausschauend zu handeln.

Wir liefern Energiemanagementlösungen, die sicherstellen, dass Unternehmen jederzeit die Kontrolle über ihre Energie behalten. Unser hauseigen entwickeltes Energiemanagementsystem (EMS) und modularer Batteriespeicher treiben Profitabilität durch Nachhaltigkeit voran und machen Unternehmen zukunftssicher. Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes, internationales Team mutiger, talentierter Menschen – von Ingenieuren und Softwareentwicklern bis hin zu kreativen Köpfen und kundenorientierten Business Developern. Egal, wo deine Stärken liegen: Wir suchen immer Menschen, die entschlossen sind, etwas Positives zu bewirken.

Die Rolle

Als (Senior) Key Account & Sales Manager bist du das Gesicht von iwell auf dem deutschen Markt für unsere gewerblichen, industriellen und Transportkunden. Du verkaufst nicht einfach Standardprodukte, sondern agierst als strategischer Partner für wegweisende Energielösungen – ein starkes, kombiniertes Angebot aus BESS, EMS und O&M-Services.

  • Consultative Selling & Co-Creation: Du verstehst den Kunden und seine Anforderungen genau und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihm eine maßgeschneiderte Lösung aus dem iwell-Produktportfolio. Dabei orchestrierst du Elemente vor Ort wie PV-Anlagen, Ladeinfrastruktur für E-Fahrzeuge und BESS und kommunizierst das EMS-Angebot von iwell klar und verständlich.

  • Business Development & Pipeline-Management: Du identifizierst, akquirierst und entwickelst strategische Schlüsselkunden und Partner im gesamten CCI-Markt (Gewerbekunden, Industriekunden sowie Energiegemeinschaften/Kommunen). Du baust durch Recherche, Networking und gezielte Ansprache eine belastbare Pipeline auf und steuerst den gesamten Vertriebszyklus vom Kaltkontakt bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag – mit Unterstützung unseres internationalen Teams.

  • Beziehungsmanagement: Du agierst als vertrauensvoller Berater auf Augenhöhe – vom Energiemanager in der Schwerindustrie bis zum Entscheider auf C-Level und Installationsunternehmen. Du besuchst Kunden und Partner, präsentierst die Lösungen von iwell und pflegst starke Beziehungen, die Zufriedenheit, Kundenbindung und Weiterempfehlungen fördern.

  • Vertragsabschluss: Du verhandelst Verträge und schließt Deals ab, die sowohl den Unternehmenszielen als auch den Kundenbedürfnissen gerecht werden, und sorgst so für beiderseitige Zufriedenheit.

  • Die Zukunft mitgestalten: Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, optimierst unsere Vertriebsstrategie für maßgeschneiderte Lösungen in der DACH-Region – einschließlich Go-to-Market-Ansätzen, etwa für den Transportsektor – und hilfst mit, unsere Prozesse noch intelligenter zu gestalten.

Was wir suchen

  • Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in kaufmännischen und/oder vertriebsnahen Rollen mit.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in mindestens einem der folgenden Bereiche: gewerbliche, industrielle oder elektrifizierte Transportprojekte, Batteriespeichersektor.

  • Du verfügst über ein Netzwerk in relevanten Kundensegmenten wie eMobility, Transportunternehmen mit Lkw und Bussen, Logistikimmobilien, Energieinstallateuren/EPCs und/oder Schwerindustrie mit Elektrifizierungsbedarf.

  • Du kommunizierst schriftlich und mündlich ausgezeichnet auf Deutsch und sicher auf Englisch. Niederländischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil!

  • Idealerweise hast du bereits mit Hubspot oder einem anderen CRM-System gearbeitet.

  • Du verfügst über einen Bachelorabschluss (Masterabschluss bevorzugt) in einem relevanten Fachbereich, z. B. Betriebswirtschaft, Ingenieurwesen o. Ä., oder über langjährige, fundierte Branchenerfahrung.

  • Du wohnst in Deutschland und bist bereit, innerhalb des Landes zu reisen sowie an Branchenmessen bzw. Networking-Veranstaltungen im In- und Ausland teilzunehmen, wenn erforderlich. Gelegentliche Reisen zu unserem Hauptsitz in Utrecht, Niederlande, sind ebenfalls Teil der Rolle.

  • Wöchentliche Arbeitszeit von 40 Stunden.

  • Präsenz im Büro an 3-4 Tagen pro Monat.

Was wir bieten

  • Für diese Position bieten wir eine variable Vergütung zusätzlich zu deinem monatlichen Gehalt.

  • 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr, plus einen jährlichen dreitägigen Firmenausflug.

  • Die Möglichkeit, dich ehrenamtlich zu engagieren – wir bieten 1 freiwilligen Tag pro Jahr.

  • Ein Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.500 EUR pro Jahr.

  • Attraktive Altersvorsorge bei Allianz mit einem Arbeitgeberanteil von 5 %.

  • Du bist herzlich eingeladen, unser deutsches Büro täglich zu nutzen – verpflichtend ist dies jedoch nicht. Anwesenheit ist erforderlich bei regelmäßigen, im Voraus geplanten Teamevents in Deutschland sowie bei ca. 2 Tagen pro Monat an unserem Hauptsitz in den Niederlanden.

  • 2 Wochen pro Jahr Remote-Arbeit möglich (Land deiner Wahl).

Interessiert?

The team 🧑‍🤝‍🧑

UpSlide is a productivity platform for Microsoft 365 (PowerPoint, Excel and Word) built for financial professionals in investment banking, private equity, asset management and advisory. Product Marketing sits at the centre of Product, Sales and Marketing: we decide how UpSlide is positioned, priced and sold.

You'll join as our Head of Product Marketing, reporting directly to Matteo Bordin, our Chief Product Officer.

You'll manage one PMM and over time grow your team.

Day-to-day, you'll work closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing leadership. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll set direction and still get into the work.

Team goals 🎯

Product Marketing's job is to make UpSlide easy to understand, easy to sell, and priced right. Concretely, that means:

  • Sharpen positioning and messaging so prospects grasp the value fast.

  • Arm Sales to win, especially against direct competitors.

  • Own pricing and packaging decisions and the reasoning behind them.

  • Run customer communications that drive adoption and expansion.

The impact on the business is direct: higher win rates, stronger pricing power, shorter sales cycles.

Your responsibilities 🖋️

Positioning & narrative (25%)

  • Own UpSlide's positioning and messaging across segments and personas.

  • Turn product capabilities into a clear story that resonates with financial professionals.

  • Keep messaging consistent across the website, sales materials and campaigns.

Sales enablement & competitive intelligence (25%)

  • Build the enablement that helps Sales qualify, pitch and close: decks, battlecards, objection handling and one-pagers.

  • Own competitive intelligence: track competitors, brief the business, keep our differentiation sharp.

  • Partner with Sales leadership on win/loss analysis and act on what it tells you.

Pricing & packaging (20%)

  • Own pricing and packaging: structure, tiers, and the logic behind them.

  • Run the analysis and make clear recommendations to the exec team.

  • Support Sales on deal-level pricing and commercial strategy.

Customer communications (15%)

  • Own how we communicate with customers: launches, releases and lifecycle comms.

  • Drive adoption and expansion through clear, well-timed messaging.

Team leadership (15%)

  • Lead, coach, and grow the PMM you’ll manage.

  • Set priorities and hold a high bar on output.

Your goals ⚡

First 3 months: Learn the product, customers and competitors in depth. Build relationships with Sales and Product. Audit our current positioning, pricing and enablement, and tell us where the gaps are.

By 6 months: Ship a refreshed positioning and messaging framework. Stand up a repeatable competitive intelligence rhythm. Deliver a first pricing and packaging recommendation.

By 9 months: Have an enablement program running that measurably improves win rates, pricing changes live or in flight, and a customer communications cadence the business relies on.

As UpSlide grows, this role can grow into broader marketing leadership. We'll back you to get there.

  • Significant experience in enterprise B2B sales: you've either carried a quota in complex, high-value deals or worked hand in hand with sellers who do. This is a must.

  • A proven product marketing track record: positioning, messaging and sales enablement that moved the needle.

  • Experience owning or heavily influencing pricing and packaging decisions.

  • People leadership experience: you've managed and developed marketers.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English, and the judgement to write for an exec audience.

We'd love it if:

✨ If you don't tick all the boxes but you think you'd be a great fit, please apply and tell us why.

  • Manager interview with Matteo Bordin, CPO (45 min to 1h30, video or in person): product thinking and experience.

  • Peer interview with a peer from Product, Marketing, and Sales (~45 min).

🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive!

What we offer

Infinos ist eine der größten Telemedizin-Plattformen für medizinische Abnehmtherapie in Deutschland. Wir machen einen mittleren 7-stelligen Jahresumsatz und haben bis heute kein Investorengeld genommen. Zwei Gründer, ein Team von rund 8 Leuten, tausende Patienten, die wir jeden Monat begleiten.

Ich bin Linus, einer der beiden Gründer und habe die Creatives für unsere Ads bisher zum großen Teil selbst gemacht. Das Marketing wächst schneller, als ich es neben allem anderen leisten kann. Deshalb suche ich die Person, die diesen Bereich übernimmt und mit uns ausbaut.

Was du machst

  • Den Markt beobachten: was die Konkurrenz in Deutschland und im Ausland schaltet und was im Abnehmmarkt außerhalb der Medizin funktioniert.

  • Daraus testbare Konzepte machen, jeweils mit klarer Hypothese und mehreren Hooks, und davon jede Woche neue an den Start bringen.

  • Creatives selbst bauen, vor allem mit KI: Statics, Animationen und Schnitte aus vorhandenem Material.

  • Drehs organisieren, mit uns Gründern, unserem Team und UGC-Creator, von Briefing und Skript bis zur Abnahme.

  • Auswerten, was läuft und daraus die nächste Runde ableiten.

  • Später dazu: unseren Newsletter und Shortform-Content für TikTok und Reels.

Deine ersten 90 Tage

  • Woche 1: deine erste eigene Ad ist live.

  • Monat 1: Marktbeobachtung und Ideenplanung laufen über dich und jede Woche gehen neue Tests von dir raus.

  • Monat 3: du gibst deine Ads selbst frei, kennst die Regeln für Werbung im Gesundheitsbereich sicher und hast einen Plan, wie wir organisch auf Shortform wachsen.

Wen wir suchen

  • Du hast schon Creatives für Paid Social gebaut, die gelaufen sind und weißt, warum sie funktioniert haben. Wie groß das Budget dahinter war, ist zweitrangig.

  • Du baust selbst, statt nur zu briefen, und arbeitest dafür täglich mit KI-Tools für Bild, Video, Stimme und Text.

  • Du schreibst gute deutsche Hooks und Skripte. Sehr gute deutsche Sprachkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind deshalb Voraussetzung.

  • Du verstehst, warum jemand mit Übergewicht nach Hilfe sucht und warum er sie dann oft doch nicht annimmt und du schreibst darüber ohne Herablassung.

  • Du hast Lust, dich in die Regeln für Werbung im Gesundheitsbereich einzuarbeiten. Was wir zeigen dürfen und was nicht, bringen wir dir bei.

  • Du willst die Stelle in Vollzeit machen und nicht nebenbei.

Hilfreich, aber nicht nötig: Erfahrung in Health, Fitness oder Ernährung oder mit anderer regulierter Werbung, ein Netzwerk an UGC-Creator, Videoschnitt. Wenn du aus dem Performance-Marketing kommst und kreativer arbeiten willst, bewirb dich trotzdem.

Was wir bieten

  • €48.000–60.000 Fixgehalt, je nach Erfahrung.

  • Virtuelle Unternehmensanteile aus unserem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungspool (VSOP). Die Höhe besprechen wir im ersten Gespräch.

  • KI-Tooling ohne Budgetgrenze.

  • Remote mit regelmäßigen Teamtreffen vor Ort und freier Zeiteinteilung, solange die Arbeit stimmt.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit beiden Gründern und ehrliches Feedback in beide Richtungen.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub.

So bewirbst du dich

Kein Anschreiben. Im Bewerbungsformular hier auf join fragen wir dich zwei Dinge: warum du die richtige Person für diese Rolle bist, mit deiner Erfahrung und dem, was du bisher erreicht hast, gern mit Zahlen. Und welche unserer Ads aus der Meta Ad Library du anders machen würdest, mit einem Satz, wie.

Wir antworten innerhalb von 3 Tagen. Dann:

  1. 30 Minuten Videocall mit Jan und mir. Wir erzählen, wie wir arbeiten und warum es die Stelle gibt. Du erzählst uns, was du bisher gemacht hast und was du suchst.

  2. Eine Probeaufgabe von etwa 4 bis 5 Stunden: Markt anschauen, ein Testpaket entwickeln und ein Creative fertig bauen.

  3. 30 Minuten, in denen du uns die Probeaufgabe vorstellst und wir über die Erwartungen beider Seiten sprechen.

  4. Angebot, schriftlich. Vom ersten Gespräch bis hierhin brauchen wir in der Regel zwei bis drei Wochen.

jobs.title: Head of Growth Europa (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
10ML ist ein europäischer Parfum-Händler, und die Parfum-Abfüllungen und Proben von 10ML in 3 ml, 10 ml und 30 ml sind ein einfacher Weg, Designer- und Nischendüfte zu entdecken. Als Head of Growth verantwortest du die gesamte Wachstumsmaschine in Europa: Akquise, Conversion, Kundenbindung und Expansion in neue Länder und Kanäle.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die Wachstumsstrategie und ihre Kennzahlen: Neukunden, Conversion Rate, durchschnittlicher Bestellwert, Wiederkaufrate und Payback in allen europäischen Märkten

  • Du führst die Verantwortlichen für Performance Marketing, SEO, CRM und Partnerschaften, setzt ihre Ziele und gibst ihnen das Budget, um zu gewinnen

  • Du steuerst ein konsequentes Testing-Programm für Website, Checkout, Angebote und Onboarding

  • Du planst Markteintritte und Lokalisierung in neuen EU-Ländern gemeinsam mit Content, Kundenservice und Operations

  • Du baust Forecasts und Reportings, mit denen die Geschäftsleitung entscheidet, wohin der nächste Euro fließt

  • Du machst Parfum-Abfüllungen von 10ML zum selbstverständlichen Weg, einen Duft vor dem Flakonkauf zu testen

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 8 Jahre in Growth oder Performance Marketing im D2C-E-Commerce, bei Marktplätzen oder Konsumgütermarken, davon mindestens 3 Jahre mit Führungsverantwortung

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge beim profitablen Skalieren bezahlter und organischer Kanäle in mehreren europäischen Ländern

  • Sicher im Umgang mit Unit Economics: CAC, LTV, Deckungsbeitrag, Kohortenbindung

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit GA4, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads und Analysen auf SQL-Niveau

  • Fließendes Englisch; Deutsch oder eine weitere EU-Sprache ist ein großes Plus

  • Bonus: Erfahrung in Beauty, Duft, Kosmetik oder Luxus-Retail

Über 10ML

10ML ist ein europäischer Parfum-Händler mit Hauptsitz in Dortmund. Seit der Gründung 2025 verkauft 10ML originale Designer- und Nischendüfte als Parfum-Abfüllungen und Proben in 3 ml, 10 ml und 30 ml. 10ML kauft bei autorisierten EU-Distributoren und direkt bei den Marken ein und füllt jedes Parfum selbst ab. Nach eigenen Angaben hat 10ML mehr als 100.000 Kundinnen und Kunden.

Der Jahresumsatz über alle Vertriebskanäle liegt 2026 bei knapp 21 Millionen Euro. Der ARR von 10ML liegt bei mehr als 10 Millionen Euro.

Was 10ML bietet

  • Ein Gehalt an der Spitze des Marktes plus einen jährlichen Leistungsbonus

  • Remote-Arbeit überall in der EU (sofern die Stelle nicht vor Ort ist) oder das Büro in Dortmund, wenn du lieber dort arbeitest

  • 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub

  • 2.000 € persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr, dazu Konferenzen

  • Ein monatliches Duftbudget, um den Katalog an Parfum-Abfüllungen von 10ML zu entdecken

  • Ein erstklassiger Laptop und die Tools, die du brauchst

  • Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und in Dortmund ein voll bezahltes Deutschlandticket

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, echte Verantwortung und Budgets, die zum Anspruch passen

So bewirbst du dich

Schick deinen Lebenslauf und alles, was deine Arbeit zeigt (Portfolio, Links, Ergebnisse), an ----- mit dem Stellentitel im Betreff. Arbeitssprache ist Englisch; Deutsch ist ein Plus, sofern die Stelle nichts anderes sagt.
