jobs.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

Checkout.com are actively looking for an enthusiastic and talented Senior Sales Manager to join our Commercial Team in London to drive rapid growth for our revolutionary Card Issuing solution. We need a high-achieving individual to help global enterprises launch modern card programs—from virtual cards for travel intermediaries to physical cards for BNPL.

If you are a driven and focused salesperson with a proven track record of selling cutting edge issuing solutions in a high-growth and competitive environment, this is the role for you. In return, on top of a tremendous working environment, we offer you an unrivalled uncapped recurring commissions plan.

Reporting to the Director, the Senior Sales Manager will handle multiple sales cycles, always ensuring a high conversion rate and outperforming the sales targets.

Along the way, you'll collaborate closely with various in-house talents across Technology and Business to position our capabilities, products, services and solutions effectively with prospects. The ideal candidate will need to be an independent, high-achieving individual, able to stand out in an entrepreneurial environment and outperform sales targets through personal drive.

 

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Pipeline Growth: Identify the most promising clients and grow a healthy pipeline for card issuing across various verticals.

  • Solution Selling: Sell our issuing products to travel intermediaries and fintech clients through outbound techniques.

  • Consultative Expert: Help prospects evaluate Checkout.com, handling detailed questions about our product capabilities, serving as a consultant and industry expert.

  • Proposal Management: Prepare thorough presentations and proposals that highlight the ROI of switching to a modern issuer.

  • Full Cycle Orchestration: Lead the entire Sales process, acting as the main point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders.

  • Collaboration: Partner with other Sales team members to share best practices, key business insights and industry trends

  • Market Intelligence: Provide feedback on local trends including competitor insights, customer needs, sales, product and marketing information

 

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 5+ years of Sales experience, with at least 3 years specifically within Payments or Card Issuing.

  • Network: A solid network of potential prospects and partners.

  • AI & Productivity: Proficient in leveraging AI-powered sales tools to augment prospecting and analyze deal intelligence to accelerate the sales cycle.

  • Technical Passion: Tech-savvy with a passion for how technology is transforming finance.

  • Business Acumen: Solid understanding of financial factors, including interchange mechanics and card scheme products.

  • Soft Skills: Exceptional communication and negotiation techniques, with the ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

  • Tools: Knowledge of Salesforce and a highly organized approach to prioritizing shifting workloads.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

jobs.title: Director of Quality
jobs.description:
About LILT

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone, regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1—guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation, Canva, the United States Department of Defense, the United States Air Force, ASICS, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

Location: Remote or hybrid, EMEA or US Eastern time zone

Team: Production, Quality

Reports to: VP Production

Direct reports: Quality Manager (AMER, customer staffing) and 2 Quality Coordinators

About the role

As Director of Quality, you will own LILT's quality system end to end: standards, audit, compliance, procedures, continuous improvement, and the roadmap and operation of our Quality Agents. You'll help move Quality from a primarily reactive, execution-led function to a proactive, data-driven partner for customers and internal teams, with quality designed into our AI-native workflows.

You'll be the person who can run a customer audit while simultaneously shipping an improved agent evaluation. As the single Quality partner for Customer Success, Production, Research and Product, you'll turn customer requirements into measurable acceptance criteria, effective controls and better models and workflows. You'll advise customers on the right quality, cost and speed mix, including where automated, agent-verified and human-verified workflows are appropriate, with stronger assurance for high-risk and regulated content.

We're looking for a hands-on Quality SME and operator with real depth in both worlds: experience designing and building AI agents and improving LLM output, and a solid grounding in traditional quality management. You'll bring senior expertise in data, AI, customer advisory and process, and make sure quality work prevents recurrence rather than stopping at rework or ticket closure.

What you'll do

Quality Agent leadership

  • Evaluate, design and build reliable Quality Agents with well-defined tools and clear, structured instructions.

  • Use orchestration patterns to evolve from a single agent to multi-agent systems.

  • Define evaluation criteria, test sets and success metrics for agent performance, and run agents in production with clear monitoring and escalation paths.

  • Drive adoption across teams and show measurable reductions in manual quality effort.

Research and Product partnership

  • Work closely with Research and Product on ADQ, LLM model improvements, AI Review, AI QA, and new and emerging AI workflows.

  • Turn quality findings into product requirements, evaluation criteria and continuous feedback loops that improve model and workflow output.

  • Act as the voice of quality in roadmap discussions, and help decide where human review, AI review or both are needed.

Audit, compliance and procedure

  • Own LILT's approach to internal and external audits, including ISO certification (e.g. ISO 17100, ISO 18587, ISO 9001) and customer audits.

  • Plan and run periodic internal audits, manage evidence collection, and track corrective and preventive actions to closure.

  • Standardise and maintain SOPs, workflows and quality documentation, and keep them current as AI workflows change how we work.

  • Make sure quality processes meet customer, contractual and regulatory requirements.

Customer advisory

  • Partner with Customer Success and Delivery to define proactive quality programmes, success metrics and governance for strategic accounts, including AI-forward enterprise and life science / regulatory programmes.

  • Translate customer quality requirements into clear pre-delivery acceptance criteria, validation methods and risk-appropriate controls.

  • Advise customers on the right quality, cost and speed mix and where automated, agent-verified, human-verified or combined workflows are appropriate.

  • Represent LILT's quality function as a credible subject-matter authority in customer business reviews, audits and escalations, using quality data and metrics to demonstrate fitness for purpose.

Continuous improvement

  • Lead structured CI across the Commercial business: root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, KPI reviews and retrospectives.

  • Own a proactive quality metrics framework that makes errors, PQs, rework and trends visible, and use it to prioritise improvements and demonstrate outcomes.

  • Strengthen quality controls across review, delivery and follow-through, including mandatory account-specific checks, intervention on critical findings and clear escalation ownership.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to automate checks and escalation, and verify that corrective actions prevent recurrence rather than ending at rework or ticket closure.

Expert Operations partnership

  • Partner with Expert Supply and Ops to embed processes, guidance and quality feedback that maintain a high-quality pipeline of experts.

  • Use quality findings and recurring failure patterns to improve expert qualification, guidance and ongoing quality management.

Team leadership

  • Lead and develop the Quality team, including the customer-facing Quality Manager and Quality Coordinators.

  • Establish the team's operating cadence and evolve how the team works as Quality Agents reduce manual coordination work.

  • Oversee embedded Quality Manager staffing sold as a service to customers, ensuring the role owns the specific quality programmes and initiatives those customers pay for.

  • Develop playbooks for AI-driven quality management and keep staffing-as-a-service delivery aligned with LILT's quality standards.

What you'll bring

Must have

  • Agent design and build: demonstrable, hands-on experience designing, building and running LLM-based agents in production. Please be ready to walk us through agents you have built.

  • Data-driven quality management: scripting or data skills (e.g. Python, SQL), with experience turning quality data into actionable metrics, preventive controls and measurable improvements.

  • LLM model improvement: proven experience improving LLM output quality.

  • Significant experience running quality systems, including leading audits (internal and external), compliance programmes, and writing and maintaining processes and procedures. Quality certifications such as Six Sigma are a plus.

  • Experience leading structured CI (RCA, CAPA, KPI reviews).

  • Experience managing and developing people.

  • Customer advisory and cross-functional partnership: a clear communicator who can translate customer quality requirements into acceptance criteria and governance, advise on quality, cost and speed trade-offs, and work credibly with customers, executives and technical teams.

Nice to have

  • Background in localisation, translation or language services.

  • Experience in customer-facing quality roles for enterprise accounts.

  • Research and Product collaboration: a track record of working with research scientists and product managers to turn quality insight into product requirements and shipped improvements.

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

Our Tech

What sets our platform apart:

  • Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent

  • Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing

  • 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

  • Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review


LILT in the News

  • Featured in The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies!

  • LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List.

  • LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.

  • Check out all our news on our website.

jobs.description:
Your Role

As Senior Product Manager – Digital Clients (f/m/d) you own the complete growth loop for LIQID's digitally-led clients: from a newly created lead to the first investment, and from there to the next top-up, the second portfolio and the next product. Acquisition and expansion sit in one team with one mandate, so you build a single growth system instead of handing clients over at the funnel's end. LIQID is hybrid by design: for this segment the experience is digital-first, and you decide precisely where a human touch from our advisors accelerates conversion or growth – and where it doesn't.

What you'll do

  • End-to-End Segment Ownership: Own the digital client lifecycle from Lead → Signup → Checkout → First Investment → Activation → Expansion. You define the segment's North Star and KPI tree across conversion and expansion – lead-to-funded conversion, time to fund, time to first top-up, multi-product rate, share of wallet – and you are accountable for net new money from the segment, not for a single funnel stage.

  • Lead Conversion & Onboarding Experience: Design and optimize the journeys that turn leads into funded clients – lead nurturing, signup, onboarding and checkout – together with Product Design, Marketing and Sales. You shape the first-product strategy – which entry offer converts which persona – and make sure the brand promise and premium positioning carry through every step that builds trust and drives conversion.

  • Digital Up- & Cross-Sell: Turn first-time investors into multi-product clients: top-ups and savings plans, second portfolios, additional account types and access to new asset classes such as private markets. You find natural product sequences through path and cohort analysis, build the in-product moments and lifecycle campaigns that convert them, and prove impact with causal measurement rather than correlation stories.

  • Hybrid Where It Pays Off: Define when a human touch turns a hesitant prospect into a client or a single-product client into a long-term relationship – callback offers at checkout drop-off, advisor triggers at wealth thresholds, and a clean handover to our Private Wealth team as clients grow. Every human touchpoint is designed, triggered and measured, not left to chance.

  • Thought Leadership with Hands-on Mentality: Act as Product Manager and Product Owner for a cross-functional team of Engineering, Design and Product Ops, working closely with Marketing and Sales. Y ou build on shared onboarding and banking infrastructure owned by our platform teams, prioritize transparently by impact and effort – which also means saying no – and grow into the thought leader for digital wealth growth at LIQID.

What you bring

  • Background: 7+ years in Product Management or Growth for digital consumer products, with ownership of both conversion and monetization or expansion outcomes. FinTech, WealthTech, banking or subscription businesses are a strong plus.

  • Growth & Analytical Depth: Hands-on with funnel, cohort and LTV analysis. You define metrics before you build, establish baselines, can query data yourself, and know the difference between a significant result and a lucky one.

  • Technical & AI Fluency: Experience working with product analytics and CRM data. You are comfortable discussing architecture and API trade-offs with engineers and use AI tooling to prototype, analyze and ship faster.

  • Domain Curiosity & Client Empathy: Genuine interest in investing and capital markets, and an understanding that converting someone to invest a significant share of their wealth is a trust decision, not an impulse purchase.

  • Communication & Language: Fluent in German and English, able to align Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing and Sales around one growth agenda and to represent your roadmap credibly toward leadership. Drive & Motivation: Comfortable in fast-paced, high-ownership scale-up environments. Y ou want to own outcomes, not backlogs, and you are excited to build the growth engine of a digital-first wealth manager in an AI-native product organization.

What we offer

  • Diversity: Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one.

  • Flexibility: We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind.

  • Appreciation: You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas.

  • Development: We support your personal and professional growth with an annual development budget up to €1,500. Additionally, at the start of your tenure at LIQID, you’ll receive high-quality equipment, including a MacBook, headphones, and a display.

  • Smart Money: As a LIQIDian, you'll enjoy attractive terms for our investment strategies, a monthly lunch allowance, and exclusive discounts with various providers.

  • Well-being: Regional organic products keep you fit in the office, and our health initiatives or Health Assistance Program go far beyond that.

What happens next

An excellent candidate, experience and transparency are our top priorities in the interview process. The different stages help us understand how a potential collaboration could look.

  1. Initial Call with our Talent Partner: A casual introduction and discussion to align your expectations with the role.

  2. Video Call with Head of Product: You will learn more about the performance expectations and specific role requirements from our leadership team.

  3. Take-home Assessment with live Presentation round: A take home task, followed by a 90-minute live session with two team members.

  4. In-Person Meeting: You will meet some team members onsite, tour our office and sit down with our Head of Product to discuss final alignments.

 

About us

We are LIQID, one of the fastest-growing fintechs in Europe. Our purpose is to provide creators, entrepreneurs, and thinkers shaping our future with access to the same opportunities as the world’s most successful investors while balancing the demands of people, planet, and profit.

We offer our clients financial peace of mind through exceptional, curated investment solutions – ranging from the world’s best private equity and venture funds to award-winning wealth management solutions. All delivered via an intuitive digital experience with outstanding personal support. With over €4 billion in assets, we are backed by leading investors from the digital, private equity, and wealth management space, including LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust, and Project A.

jobs.title: Director Research & Development
jobs.description:
Purpose of the job

The Director Research & Development (R&D) leads the exploration and development of potential business and technology initiatives, from initial ideation through feasibility analysis, testing, validation and proof of concept (POC)/prototyping. For assigned initiatives, the role coordinates the full exploration phase and develops substantiated proposals for consideration and approval by the relevant governance bodies.

 

The role requires a proactive, self-motivated approach, the ability to work independently and to manage multiple subjects concurrently. Initiatives may range from joint venture (JV) model enhancements and artificial intelligence (AI) to customer experience development and new approaches to distribution.

 

KEY RESULT AREAS/ KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 

Ideation and concept generation

  • Ensure that potential initiatives align with SkyTeam’s strategic goals and assess their purpose, expected value, rationale and the implications of not proceeding.
  • Ask relevant questions and gather appropriate information to support well-founded recommendations and help build consensus among member airlines.
  • Organize and facilitate ideation and brainstorming sessions.
  • Monitor developments in the transport industry and at IATA to identify emerging trends and opportunities or gaps for improving existing legacy systems.
  • Generate, collect and develop ideas and concepts in partnership with member airlines and other contributors for marketable initiatives that could become SkyTeam priorities.

 

Exploration, feasibility and concept development

  • Lead the exploration of assigned initiatives, including relevant research and data analysis, feasibility assessments, business cases, business requirements documents (BRDs) and POCs/prototypes, as appropriate.
  • Analyze business and technical challenges across different airline domains; identify and assess potential solutions and determine the most relevant product concept, design and feasibility approach.
  • Develop evidence-based recommendations, supported by tangible data and analysis, that demonstrate the potential business value of the proposed initiative.
  • Prepare proposals and supporting materials for review and approval by the relevant SkyTeam and member-airline decision-making bodies.

 

Stakeholder engagement and governance

  • Work effectively within SkyTeam’s matrix organization and collaborate with member airlines, internal teams and relevant external contributors.
  • Engage with operational and technical stakeholders, including senior decision-makers, to understand requirements, assess options and build alignment around proposed concepts.
  • Support informed decisions through clear analysis and recommendations. Strategic prioritization and formal initiative approval remain with the Executive Board (EB), Strategy Committee (StratCom) and relevant governance bodies.

 

Transition to implementation

  • Following approval, coordinate with Digital/Delivery to transfer the agreed concept, supporting analysis, business requirements and relevant POC findings for MVP development and implementation.
  • Where assigned, act as project owner or coordinate relevant project activities within the agreed governance arrangements. Accountability for implementation transfers to Digital/Delivery.
  • Budget, resource or external-partner responsibilities may be assigned depending on the approved initiative and are not standing responsibilities of the role.


Your profile

REQUIRED SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE

  • Strong airline-industry background, with demonstrated experience in core airline businesses such as PRM, distribution, operational research and e-sales.
  • Broad understanding of airline business and technical domains, sufficient to assess a variety of potential initiatives.
  • Good understanding of relevant technical aspects; experience in a Business Analyst role is an advantage.
  • Excellent facilitation skills, with the ability to engage and guide diverse groups towards innovative solutions.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain and present complex concepts and inspire teams.
  • Analytical and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to evaluate complex options and communicate evidence-based recommendations.
  • Ability to work independently on multiple subjects and collaborate effectively in a multicultural matrix organization.

Responsibilities and tasks of the position are not limited to the above mentioned, and deviations can occur at any point in time as the position evolves and in concert with the manager.


Why us?

SkyTeam will offer you a complete salary package that includes unique benefits:

  • A challenging role at a unique employer in the Netherlands
  • Salary: a competitive monthly gross salary depending on your experience
  • Vacation pay: 8% of gross annual salary
  • Vacation days: 27 vacation days for one year
  • Birthday leave: additional PTO (1 day) on or around your birthday
  • Public holiday exchange: exchange Dutch bank holidays with any bank holiday culturally significant to you
  • Pension plan: everything you need for a good retirement
  • Equipment: laptop, phone or e-sim
  • Home office: create and equip your home office with our support.
  • Travel allowance: travel allowance for public transport, bicycle, and car 
  • Discounted travel: reduced airfares after 6 months of your start date
  • Learning environment: free access to LinkedIn Learning, Lunch & Learn sessions, and the opportunity to surround yourself with highly skilled colleagues

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

We prioritise privacy as a fundamental right, delivering the most secure communication experience across various industries. Our cutting-edge encryption technology and robust security measures have made us a trusted partner in the technology, finance, healthcare, and government sectors. If you are passionate about redefining secure communication and want to be part of an innovative team, join us as a Senior Product Manager within our Product Engineering organisation. Together, let us build a world where privacy and security shape the future of communication.


GENERAL INFORMATION

  • Employment Type: 12-month contract with the possibility of extension

  • Previous working experience: 5-7 years in Product Security

  • Working hours: 40hrs/week

  • Working Location: Remote EU / Berlin

  • Desired start date: As soon as possible


YOUR CHALLENGE AT WIRE

Be ready to play an essential role by joining our Information Security Team. You will become a pioneer in transforming how organisations and governments communicate securely. You will work closely with the Director of Information Security and interact with the engineering, product, and other teams regularly. Your areas of work are:

Product Security

  • You review security- or privacy-critical changes and implement or propose solutions to potential issues

  • You help to maintain security documentation of the product with focus on product certifications

  • You communicate with internal and external stakeholders regarding product security topics

  • You support new feature development from a security point of view to identify possible security or privacy pitfalls early in the process

  • You contribute to internal security audits, risk assessments and threat modelling workshops

  • You conduct security awareness trainings regarding your field of responsibility

Platform  Security

  • You are responsible for our Platform Security controls

  • You support technical due diligence to ensure compliance with information security and data protection requirements 

  • You oversee the incident management process and team members involved in resolving the incident

  • You help to maintain documentation of security- and privacy-related processes

  • You support Wire’s identity and access management

  • You drive the implementation and maintenance of SecOps measures for our Platform


YOUR PROFILE

Essential requirements

  • Proficient understanding of secure software development practices, including threat modelling and security architecture review for products.

  • Hands-on experience assessing security and privacy risks in product features (e.g., authentication, encryption, data handling, APIs).

  • Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals (e.g., AWS) and common infrastructure tools (Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm).

  • Experience supporting security certifications/compliance frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, GDPR).

  • Strong communication skills and experience engaging both technical and non-technical stakeholders on security and privacy topics.

Strong plus

  • Ideally, you have relevant security and/or DevOps certifications, such as CKS, etc.

  • You are familiar with GitHub, Jira and Confluence.

Further qualifications and skills

  • You are a good communicator and you like to work in a team.

  • You are interested in and keep up with trends and news from the InfoSec world.

  • You are self-motivated to identify security problems and engage with teams to find solutions.

  • You like to do in-depth research on your own and present the results to the team.

  • You have programming experience, preferably with one or more of JavaScript, TypeScript, Swift, Kotlin, Java, Rust and Haskell.

  • You have a thorough understanding of security code reviews, bug triage based on common metrics like CVSS, and vulnerability management.

  • You have a practical, working understanding of basic cryptographic ciphers/algorithms and understand protocols or concepts like Elliptic Curve, TLS, Public Key Infrastructure and Messaging Layer Security.

  • You have a strong understanding of application security frameworks like OWASP Top 10.

  • You bring thorough knowledge of OAuth, SSO, Identity and Access Management systems.

  • You are willing to subject yourself to the S2 security check of the German Government.

This role can be performed remotely from Germany or another EU country. Regular travel to our Berlin office for workshops, and selected in-person collaboration sessions is expected.


WHY WIRE?

  • Join a market-proven company with more than 1,000 customers and help Wire become the trusted secure communications partner for organisations that care deeply about security and privacy.
  • Participate in Wire’s long-term success through VSOPs.
  • 30 days of vacation entitlement, allowing you to take well-deserved time off and maintain a healthy work-life balance.
  • With an Urban Sports Club subscription, stay balanced and mentally and physically healthy.
  • Investment in professional development with an annual education budget of €1,000 and access to top-notch learning resources.
  • Work from a beautiful office in the heart of Berlin or choose a mix of working from anywhere vs. spending selected days together in our office to connect on a personal level.
  • Enjoy fresh breakfast in the office, daily fruits, snacks, free soft drinks, and a nice Barista coffee machine.
  • Wire is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the grounds of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability or race.


CONTACT

Join us in shaping the future of secure communication. Click Apply now to submit your CV - we look forward to meeting you!

IMPORTANT NOTE ON RECRUITMENT FRAUD

All Wire vacancies are published on our official careers page, and every application for this position runs through Personio, our official application portal. For permanent roles we do not work with external recruitment agencies. At no point in the process will Wire, or any partner working on our behalf, ask you for payments, fees or bank details, and we never extend an offer without at least one live conversation with people from Wire. If someone contacts you claiming to represent Wire and you are unsure whether it is genuine, please get in touch with us via the support page on wire.com before you reply or share any personal data. We will check whether the contact is genuine.

jobs.description:
Our project for you:

moebel.de is Europe's leading price comparison site for furniture and home furnishings. Our family of portals operates in nine European countries, including Germany, France, Spain, the Netherlands, Italy and Poland.

Now we are getting started in earnest in the UK: living24.uk is live – our price comparison site for furniture, home furnishings, garden and décor, as well as white goods and home electronics. The launch is done, the technology works. What decides the pace now are the retailers: the more relevant shops list their ranges on living24.uk, the stronger the comparison for users – and the faster the portal grows.

This is not selling from a tidy list of existing accounts. You take on a freshly launched market and build the partner portfolio that living24.uk runs on. Whoever delivers over the next few months will shape what moebel.de looks like in the UK.

That is why we are looking for you as Senior Sales Manager UK.


Your future Tasks

  • Building the market: you build living24.uk's partner portfolio – from first contact through pitch and negotiation to the signed contract. Your targets are UK online retailers in furniture, home furnishings, garden, décor, white goods, home electronics and small appliances.
  • Selling a performance model: you show retailers how living24.uk pays off as an additional channel – through cost per click, visibility, feed quality and cost-of-sale.
  • Seeing partners through to go-live: product feed, tracking, range checks – together with the team in Hamburg. After go-live our Relationship Management team takes over day-to-day care, so you can focus on winning new partners.
  • Presence in the market: retailer visits, trade fairs and industry events across the UK. In a young market, trust is built face to face.
  • Ear to the ground: competition, price levels, what UK retailers expect, seasonality – what you learn in the field feeds into product, pricing and priorities.


Your Strenghts

  • Several years of sales experience in UK e-commerce, ideally with a price comparison site, marketplace, affiliate network or performance marketing provider
  • A solid network of UK retailers in our categories that you can put to work from day one
  • Command of the performance model: CPC, CPO, affiliate, product feeds, ROAS and cost-of-sale are selling points for you, not buzzwords
  • A hunter's mindset: you keep your own pipeline full, cold outreach included, and get deals over the line
  • An appetite for building: pace and open questions appeal to you more than a field that has already been ploughed
  • Working from the numbers, with clean CRM records as the basis for how you steer
  • Willingness to travel across the UK and to regular meetings in Hamburg
  • Fluent English at negotiation level – German is a plus, not a requirement


Our Benefits

Your day is yours to shape

Work when you are most productive. Early bird or night owl: you set your hours flexibly, in agreement with your team. Working from another European country for a while? No problem. Your laptop is your workplace.

Our culture is one of a kind

Here everyone sits on the same couch, regardless of title or role. We live team spirit online and in person – gaming nights, workouts, film evenings and team events.

Four times a year we meet for Company Week

Working together in the office, pushing projects forward, pizza evenings and a party to finish.

In the heart of Hamburg

When you are in Hamburg, our office is waiting for you – centrally located between the main station, Mönckebergstraße and the Binnenalster lake. Perfect for lunch dates, a break by the Alster or a stroll after work.


We are looking forward to receiving your application!

Please send your application exclusively through our online application form – it goes straight to our recruiting team. You are welcome to submit your CV in English or German, ideally with your salary expectations and earliest possible start date.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Base salary:  £33,990 - £43,775 per annum*  

All salaries listed on our roles are based on UK salary bands, however, if you’d like more information on the bands for your country give us a shout.

Senior Digital Marketing Specialist - fixed term 12m contract

A bit about Torchbox

We’re the leading digital marketing agency for UK and international nonprofits. We’re proud to provide digital marketing services to the NHS, Breast Cancer Now, MSI Reproductive Choices, Disasters Emergency Committee, MND Association, Mind, Diabetes UK, MS Society, Oxfam GB and many, many more charities and organisations around the world. This is a great time to join Torchbox. 

Our diverse team of over 120 people is mostly UK-based but with a significant presence in Manila as well as a network of people around the world.

We are on a mission to set a new standard for a purpose-led business. Torchbox is 100% employee-owned - everyone is a co-owner from day one and we are building an amazing, progressive ownership and learning culture. If you are excited about this mission, it’s a great time to join.

We are looking for a Senior Digital Marketing Specialist to join our award winning team on a 12 month fixed term contract.

You’ll be supporting the planning, implementation and reporting of pay-per-click (PPC) and paid social media campaigns for some of the very biggest charities and NGOs. 

This role would suit someone with a few years experience working in a hands-on digital marketing role who is looking to work with organisations who make the world a better place. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Setting up, running and optimising PPC and paid social campaigns.

  • Experience working agency-side.

  • A background in the nonprofit sector or other relevant sector

  • Carry out daily and weekly optimisation on client accounts.

  • Drafting reports to our clients using Google Analytics as your primary measurement tool. 

  • Supporting our Paid Media Account Managers in the delivery of digital marketing campaigns.

  • Working with our Account Managers to deliver ultra accurate and insightful reports. 

  • Working with our Account Managers to maintain existing client relationships.

  • Working on tasks independently as well as part of a team.


Our Senior Digital Marketing Specialists  have the following skills:

Essential

  • Some hands-on experience planning and running PPC and paid social campaigns. You will ideally be able to set up, optimise and report back on Google Ads and Facebook campaigns from day one. 

  • Outstanding client-facing skills. This is a client-facing role, so you’ll be talking to our charities every day on Zoom, and responding to their requests quickly via email and various project management tools.

  • Experience managing multiple projects or accounts concurrently. You will be looking after between 5 and 10 clients, so the ability to juggle workload, quickly switch focus and manage your own time against tight deadlines is essential. 

  • A basic knowledge of Google Analytics. You will be comfortable logging in and using it to report back on the success of your marketing campaigns.

  • Outstanding, error-free written skills. We need to communicate clearly and accurately with our clients, so you’ll need to display attention to detail. 

  • Excellent numerical skills. You will be managing and moving budgets all day every day in response to campaign performance, so you’ll need to know Google Sheets (or Excel). 

What we offer

  • Become a co-owner of Torchbox, shape our success and share in the rewards 

  • Work with awesome clients doing rewarding, purposeful work

  • Competitive salary + annual review + bonuses

  • Ethical pension scheme, with a 6% contribution from Torchbox

  • 27 days holiday, plus public holidays

  • Fully remote, hybrid, office full-time, whatever works for you

  • Training and conference budget to discover new ideas

  • Paid time off to volunteer for causes that matter to you 

  • Health schemes and access to mental health support

  • Electric car salary sacrifice scheme (UK only)

  • Wellness programme and cycle-to-work scheme, alongside other lovely things that are good for you and the environment

  • Some pretty epic socials (virtual and in-person), weekly free veggie lunches in the office  and a bunch of other cool stuff we’d love to tell you about


The money bit 

£33,990 - £43,775 per annum + a tax-free co-owner bonus & profit share 
At Torchbox, you’re not just an employee—you’re a co-owner from day one. We’re 100% employee-owned, which means you get a say in how we run things, and you directly share in our success.

Our total compensation includes:

  • Base Salary: £33,990 -£43,775 per annum

  • Tax-Free Co-Owner Bonus: A guaranteed £3,600 per year, paid quarterly (£900 every 3 months) as well as our Profit Share Scheme.


The application process

The closing date for this role is Monday 26th October 2026.

The application process will consist of 2 stages, these will be:

  • 30-minute first-stage interview, we will ask you more about your previous work experience and skills.  You’ll also get a chance to learn more about Torchbox and the role

  • A 90-minute final stage interview,  this will be a panel interview with 2-3 members of the team. We will delve more into your experience and ask you some competency-based questions. During this stage, we’d like you to complete a written task and a 5-minute presentation, we will send you details in advance.


Everyone is welcome

We’re committed to being an inclusive employer, from recruitment to everyday life.

If you need help or have questions - give us a shout - No agencies, please.

We are looking for a Client Partner to join our Public Sector team

A bit about Torchbox
We build digital products for international NGOs, governments and universities; and we created Wagtail CMS, used by Google, NASA, the NHS and thousands more. 

Our diverse team of over 120 people is mostly UK-based but with a significant presence in Manila as well as a network of people around the world.

What we’re looking for

We are seeking an experienced Client Partner to join our team. Your experience might be in Product or Service Ownership, Delivery Management, or Consulting with a digital agency. 

While account management experience is useful, we are particularly looking for candidates with client-side public sector experience, particularly in navigating complex digital projects and helping clients implement the government Service Standard. You’ll have strong experience in helping clients develop and implement effective digital services and interventions.
We recognise that candidates may not have deep expertise in every aspect of the role, so we’re open to different backgrounds. Whether you lean more towards Delivery or Product is less important than your ability to build strong relationships, guide clients through challenges, and contribute to sales efforts.

In this role, progression will be about the complexity and scale of projects and clients rather than a traditional management track. 

We’re generally a curious, creative, and caring team. If you’re passionate about helping public sector clients navigate complex challenges, improve services, and create meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you!


You will:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of public sector clients, ensuring their digital strategies align with their goals.

  • Lead combined multidisciplinary and client teams through exploration, experimentation, and implementation, drawing on relevant research, design, and technical approaches.

  • Provide the strategic direction to support teams in working in agile, iterative ways to achieve the best outcomes.

  • Work alongside a Delivery Manager, enabling you to hold the vision and strategic direction

  • Act as a navigator through relevant sector standards, helping clients understand the Service Standard and what it means for their work.

jobs.title: CISO
jobs.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 500,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Why is this role important for Pennylane?

Pennylane is building Pennylane Financial Services (PFS), a newly created regulated subsidiary applying for ACPR authorisations as a payment institution and a financing company.

This step is foundational to delivering a comprehensive financial-services product for our clients, on a model that is robust, scalable, and supervision-ready.

From day one, the ACPR will expect PFS to demonstrate clear security governance, effective oversight of critical dependencies, and credible evidence of operational resilience - with a strong security-by-design approach.

How will you contribute to the project?

You will own PFS’s security governance and overall security and resilience policy, under the direct supervision of the Chief Compliance and Risk Officer.

Your contribution is to design a risk and control framework that is proportionate to PFS’s activity and regulatory expectations, and to ensure PFS can evidence "security by design" through auditable, inspection-ready artefacts.

In practice, this includes:

  • Policy alignment: ensure consistency between PFS and Pennylane SAS security policies, leveraging the group framework where appropriate while prioritising PFS’s regulatory obligations.

  • Security by design: translate requirements into actionable standards and control expectations, embedded into product and engineering delivery.

  • Operational resilience: shape incident-management and continuity expectations, ensure they are testable, and drive evidence of effective execution.

  • Oversight of key stakeholders: establish effective oversight of Pennylane SAS and key providers, with clear expectations, monitoring and remediation follow-through.

This is a role for a technically credible security leader with strategic judgement - with the technical depth to challenge architectures, controls and evidence, and the seniority to own governance and executive reporting.

What will your day-to-day responsibilities be?

  • Own PFS Information Security policy: define, maintain and continuously improve PFS security governance, standards and policy set.

  • Manage the PFS risk and control framework: maintain the security risk taxonomy, control objectives, key risks/KRIs, escalation thresholds, and evidence expectations.

  • Embed security-by-design into the Product/Tech development cycle: leverage Pennylane SAS policies and existing ways of working where applicable, ensuring PFS security requirements and regulatory obligations are reflected in the delivery lifecycle, change process and go/no-go decisions, without creating unnecessary process overhead.

  • Ensure operational resilience / continuity / testing: define resilience requirements and ensure end-to-end testing and exercises produce usable evidence and tracked remediation.

  • Manage outsourcing arrangements and audits: oversee security aspects of outsourcing arrangements (intragroup and third parties), ensure auditability and follow through on findings and remediation.

  • Provide executive-level reporting: deliver clear, decision-oriented reporting on information-security posture, incidents, resilience testing and remediation to PFS management and the Supervisory Board.

KPIs / signals:

  • Policy & standards effectiveness: evidence of adoption (e.g., security requirements consistently reflected in delivery artefacts for material initiatives) and reduction of recurring “same class” issues over time.

  • Core security KRIs (within risk appetite): a small set of measurable KRIs with thresholds and owners (e.g., critical vulnerability exposure, privileged-access exceptions, key third-party risks), tracked and escalated when outside appetite.

  • Resilience testing KPIs: tests/exercises executed vs plan; % of high-severity findings remediated within agreed timelines; retest completion for failed scenarios.

  • Incident classification & remediation tracking: consistent classification, timely escalation, and tracked remediation to closure (including post-incident action closure rate).

  • Audit follow-up tracking: audit findings/actions ageing, % overdue by severity, and executive visibility on the top overdue items.

  • Threat & vulnerability landscape monitoring: regular review of the external threat/vulnerability landscape and its concrete impact on PFS priorities (what changes in controls, monitoring, or roadmap).

Ramp-up / expectations during the probation period:

  • Establish the initial PFS security governance baseline (policy set, decision rights, reporting cadence).

  • Propose and align a first set of PFS security KRIs and risk appetite thresholds (with owners and escalation path).

  • Produce a first resilience testing plan (what is tested, frequency, evidence expected) and agree success criteria.

  • Put in place an incident classification approach and a remediation tracking routine that is audit-ready.

Profile we are looking for

Must-have

  • Fintech and/or Banking experience

  • Strong experience in information security, technology risk, cyber-risk or security assurance, with ownership of complex topics.

  • Proven ability to design and run security governance and a risk/control framework with audit-ready evidence.

  • Experience working with outsourced / third-party / group-shared technology services while retaining accountability.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including executive-level reporting.

  • Professional fluency in French and English.

Nice to have

  • Operational resilience experience, including DORA-aligned practices (incident management, continuity, testing, third-party oversight).

  • Knowledge of payment and authentication topics (SCA, strong authentication and account recovery patterns).

  • Exposure to PCI DSS scope and payment-card security concepts.

  • Payment fraud and transaction-monitoring familiarity (fraud patterns, controls, investigations, and collaboration with Fraud/AML stakeholders).

Recruitment Process

1. Interview with Lucie (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter

2. Interview with Laurent (1h), Chief Risk & Compliance Officer

3. Case Study with Laurent and Léa (1h)

4. Last round with Stanislas and Felix (45 min)

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

jobs.title: Financial Services Regulatory Lead H/F
jobs.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!


Why is this role important for Pennylane?

Pennylane is building Pennylane Financial Services (PFS), a newly created regulated subsidiary applying for ACPR authorisations as a payment institution and a financing company.

From day one of licensing, PFS must be able to operate in full regulatory compliance - not only through policies, but through reliable execution: clear ownership, predictable reporting routines, auditable evidence, and effective coordination across Operations, Finance/Accounting and Compliance & Risk.

This role is critical to organise and run that regulatory function, with the ambition to progressively consolidate regulatory reporting ownership within PFS.

How will you contribute to the project?

You will help build and operate the regulatory office of Pennylane Financial Services, working across Compliance & Risk, Finance, Legal, Operations and Technology.

Your initial priority will be to turn PFS’s regulatory requirements into a reliable operating framework: a complete obligations inventory, clear ownership, an integrated regulatory calendar, and effective controls over regulatory reporting and evidence.

In practice, you will:

  • maintain the authoritative inventory of PFS’s regulatory obligations;

  • coordinate the regulatory-reporting portfolio and directly produce selected returns;

  • establish clear responsibilities, reporting controls and escalation paths across contributing functions;

  • support supervisory responses and commitment tracking from day one;

  • coordinate regulatory change with Compliance, Legal and the relevant subject-matter owners; and

  • support regulatory governance through clear reporting, decision tracking and follow-through.

You will not replace the specialist accountability of Finance, the MLRO, Legal, Risk or Operations. Your role will be to make their contributions converge into a controlled, timely and inspection-ready regulatory process.

As PFS grows, you will help shape and evolve its regulatory operating model and governance arrangements.

What will your day-to-day responsibilities be?

  • Maintain the regulatory-obligations inventory: keep a complete and current view of PFS’s recurring and event-driven obligations, with clear owners, deadlines, controls, approval routes and evidence requirements.

  • Run the integrated regulatory calendar: coordinate contributors, dependencies and review milestones across Compliance & Risk, Finance, Legal, Operations and Technology, escalating delivery risks before deadlines are affected.

  • Coordinate regulatory reporting: oversee the end-to-end reporting portfolio and directly prepare selected returns, while ensuring specialist functions retain accountability for their underlying judgements and data.

  • Establish reporting controls: document and operate source-to-report lineage, reconciliations, variance analysis, maker-checker review, sign-offs, submission evidence, correction procedures and backup arrangements.

  • Coordinate data-quality remediation: document reporting-data issues, assign them to the accountable function, monitor resolution and escalate overdue or recurring problems.

  • Support supervisory responses and commitment tracking: maintain a reliable record of requests, responses and commitments; coordinate contributions and evidence under the direction of the ACPR relationship owner; and escalate delivery issues to PFS management.

  • Coordinate regulatory change: work with Compliance, Legal and relevant subject-matter owners to translate new requirements into impact assessments, accountable owners, implementation plans and evidence.

  • Support regulatory governance: prepare concise status reporting, maintain decision and action tracking, and ensure regulatory matters reach the appropriate management or governance forum.

  • Improve tools and processes: define practical requirements for workflow, evidence storage, reporting production and regulatory remittance, reducing manual effort without weakening controls.

Profile we are looking for

Must-have

  • Meaningful experience in a regulated financial environment, in one or more areas such as regulatory reporting, regulatory operations, prudential reporting, compliance, risk, finance, internal control or regulatory advisory.

  • Strong understanding of reporting controls and data quality, including reconciliations, source-to-report traceability, review and approval controls, exception management and auditable evidence.

  • Sound regulatory judgement: ability to understand a requirement, identify its practical implications, recognise when specialist Legal or Compliance input is needed, and translate conclusions into ownership, processes and controls.

  • Strong execution discipline, with a demonstrated ability to coordinate recurring deliverables, manage interdependencies and meet fixed deadlines reliably.

  • Ability to work effectively across Finance, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations and Technology, while preserving clear accountability between functions.

  • Ability to build structured and durable ways of working—including registers, calendars, procedures, templates and knowledge bases—in an evolving environment.

  • Clear and concise written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain issues, assumptions and required decisions to senior stakeholders.

  • Professional fluency in French and English.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with ACPR reporting, supervisory interactions or the French regulatory environment.

  • Experience in a payment institution, electronic-money institution, financing company, bank, regulated fintech, supervisory authority or specialist advisory firm.

  • Exposure to more than one regulatory domain, such as payments, prudential reporting, statistical reporting, AML-CFT, fraud, incidents or financing activities.

  • Experience coordinating regulatory change, supervisory requests, inspections or remediation commitments.

  • Familiarity with regulatory-remittance tools, reporting-data lineage, workflow automation or evidence-management solutions.

  • Experience building or materially improving a regulatory framework in a new entity, licensing programme or operating-model transformation.

Recruitment Process

1. Interview with Simon (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter

2. Interview with Laurent (1h), Compliance&Risk Director

3. Case Study with two Finance or Legal representative (1h)

4. Team fit with two interviewers (30 min)

5. Last round with Maxime and Felix (45 min)

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains ----- or ----- style="min-height:1.5em">We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

 

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

jobs.description:
Ab sofort suchen wir einen Senior Recruiter - Vollzeit (m/w/d) in Vollzeit an unserem Standort in der Hamburger Innenstadt.

In dieser Position führst du strukturierte Qualifizierungsgespräche mit Bewerbern durch, die wir über Social-Media-Kampagnen für unsere Kunden generieren. Du prüfst, ob ein Bewerber fachlich und persönlich zum jeweiligen Unternehmen passt – und übernimmst anschließend die Terminierung der Vorstellungsgespräche.
Diese Rolle erfordert Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Prozesssicherheit und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Projektmanagern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden nur passende Bewerber vorgestellt bekommen.

Was macht die Cordes Consulting GmbH genau?

Wir sind eine Werbeagentur, welche Handwerksunternehmen durch innovative Social-Media-Strategien dabei hilft, mehr Bewerbungen von Fachkräften aus der Region zu erhalten. Wir vermarkten also mittelständische Unternehmen als attraktive Arbeitgeber in den sozialen Netzwerken und generieren für diese Bewerbungen für ihre handwerklichen Stellen. Dazu suchen wir neue Recruiter (m/w/d), um diese Bewerber zu kontaktieren und Bewerbungsgespräche bei unseren Kunden zu terminieren.

Aufgabengebiete:

  • Du führst telefonische Vorgespräche mit Bewerbern, die wir über unsere Kampagnen generieren

  • Du prüfst, ob die Bewerber für die jeweilige Stelle geeignet sind – anhand klarer Kriterien

  • Du triffst eine Vorauswahl und organisierst Vorstellungsgespräche bei unseren Kunden

  • Du dokumentierst alle Gesprächsergebnisse sorgfältig in unserem Bewerbermanagementsystem

  • Du übermittelst den Bewerbern relevante Informationen zum Job und zum Arbeitgeber

  • Du arbeitest nach festen Gesprächsleitfäden und standardisierten Prozessen

Wenn du weitere Informationen zu unserem Unternehmen und deiner Karriere bei Cordes Consulting haben möchtest, findest du diese auf www.cordes-karriere.de.

Gehalt: Senior Recruiter (m/w/d): 5.100 € brutto im Monat.
Die Einarbeitungsphase dauert in der Regel 2–4 Monate.


Das erwartet Dich bei uns:

  • Eine gute Vergütung über dem Branchendurchschnitt.

  • Ausführliche interne Schulung: Durch unser internes Schulungssystem lernst du alles, was du für deine neue Tätigkeit bei uns im Unternehmen benötigst.

  • Hervorragende Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Über die nächsten Jahre werden wir weiter stark wachsen.

  • Einen tollen Firmenstandort in der Hamburger Innenstadt mit moderner Arbeitsausstattung.

  • Eine tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Uns ist ein positives Umfeld wichtig. Der Umgang untereinander ist sehr kollegial und familiär. Wir ziehen alle am gleichen Strang.

  • Ein dynamisches Team ein motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld.

  • Einen sichereren Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Das Ziel jeder Einstellung ist eine unbefristete Übernahme.

  • Eine erstklassige Büroausstattung: Wir arbeiten ausschließlich mit moderner Technik und Arbeitsausstattung.

  • Wir übernehmen die Kosten für dein Deutschlandticket oder einen Tiefgaragenstellplatz in unserem Bürogebäude.

  • Cordes Consulting Gesundheitssystem: Profitiere von umfangreichen Gesundheitsleistungen für dich und deine Familienangehörigen (u. a. 900 € jährliches Gesundheitsbudget für Privatleistungen, Facharzt-Terminvereinbarung innerhalb von 5-10 Tagen, ärztliche Zweitmeinung sowie ein 24/7 Gesundheitstelefon)


  • Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich BWL, Marketing oder Personalwesen

  • Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung (mindestens 5 Jahre) in den Themenbereichen Recruiting, Projektmanagement oder Personalmarketing

  • Ausgeprägtes analytisch-methodisches und strukturiertes Denken, hohe Organisationsfähigkeit, Ergebnis- und Lösungsorientierung sowie Teamorientierung gepaart mit sicherem Auftreten, einer eigenständigen Arbeitsweise und einem hohen Maß an Kommunikationsfähigkeit

  • Die Fähigkeit, bestehende Prozesse nicht nur zu befolgen, sondern auch aktiv zu optimieren und weiterzuentwickeln

  • Sehr schnelle Auffassungsgabe und ausgeprägte Disziplin

  • Exzellente kommunikative Fähigkeiten und ein starkes Gespür für Präzision

  • Stilsichere, saubere und fehlerfreie schriftliche Ausdrucksform in Deutsch

  • Guter Umgang mit Leistungsdruck

jobs.title: Senior Key Account Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description:
Are you driven by building meaningful customer partnerships that deliver real commercial impact? Do you want to take ownership of key accounts while helping shape best practices and elevate the team around you? Famly is looking for a Senior Key Account Manager to drive retention, growth, and deep partnerships across our UK enterprise accounts.

As a Senior Key Account Manager at Famly, you will operate at the highest level of strategic account ownership and take the lead on our largest and most complex partnerships.

Solutions-focused and positive, you thrive in a fast-paced environment - skilfully navigating opportunities to accelerate commercial growth and deepen customer love at every turn. You’re not only a master of relationship management and growth - you’re also a driving force behind team excellence and customer-centric innovation.

🚀 What you'll be doing

This isn't just about managing a book of business; it's about operating at the highest level of strategic account ownership and influencing our overall Key Accounts team.

  • Lead our most valuable and complex accounts with an executive-level approach. You'll build deep, multi-threaded relationships with senior stakeholders.

  • Design and deliver long-term account strategies, driving expansion, retention, and strategic alignment.

  • Identify and close significant upsell opportunities through deep commercial and consultative work.

  • Enable other Key Account Managers (KAMs), supporting onboarding, peer reviews and skills development.

  • Act as a voice of the customer across Product, Sales and CX, helping align internal teams with client needs

  • Own forecasting and portfolio reporting for leadership, ensuring clarity on growth, risks, and outcomes.


🌟 What you bring

You're a master of relationship management and growth, and a driving force behind team excellence.

  • 3+ years’ experience in a similar role.

  • Executive-level communication and strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders.

  • A positive, solutions-focused mindset, seeing every challenge as an opportunity to strengthen customer trust and fuel commercial growth.

  • Commercial Sharpness: You understand what drives growth and take ownership of outcomes.

  • Strategic and creative thinking with the ability to align customer objectives with Famly's business goals.

  • Calm Under Pressure: You handle high-stakes challenges and escalations with maturity and confidence, ensuring customer trust and retention.

  • Proficiency in CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and the ability to analyze customer data.

💡 What excites you

You thrive when you are:

  • Taking the lead on our largest and most complex partnerships.

  • Leading high-impact Business Reviews that set direction, unlock growth, and drive retention.

  • Having a clear, measurable impact on the performance and development of your peers and the wider team.

  • Turning challenges into opportunities that strengthen customer happiness.

  • Thinking in systems, not just tasks, with a vision-driven approach.

  • Satisfying customers who see you as a long-term partner.

🎯 What excites us

  • Top-tier account growth and retention metrics across your portfolio (e.g., Net Revenue Retention and strategic account expansion rate).

  • Your influence on process, tooling, or strategy that significantly enhances team effectiveness.

  • Forecasts and reporting that leadership trusts and acts on.

  • Your contributions to building, refining, and scaling key account processes, tooling, and best practices.

  • A collaborative and inclusive presence that makes others better by being in the room.

And who are Famly...? 🤔

At Famly, we're on a mission to give children the best possible start to life by supporting the people who make that happen every day: early-years professionals.

It all started when our co-founder Henrik dropped off his daughter at daycare and realised how much was still being done with pen and paper—and how distant that made him feel from her day. Together with Anders, now our CEO, they set out to build software that bridges that gap.

Today, Famly is used by 34,000+ childcare professionals and hundreds of thousands of parents to:

  • Communicate in real-time

  • Reduce admin stress

  • Improve planning, pedagogy, and finances

  • And ultimately, give more time to the little ones that matter most

Want to help us do even more of that? We’d love to have you.

🚀 Why you’ll love working with Famly

  • You’ll be surrounded by clever, kind people who support each other

  • We give you ownership—freedom to try new things, backed by trust

  • Top-tier equipment (noise-cancelling headphones included)

  • Onsite learning from peers, leaders and coaches as well as regular team and company activities

  • Ongoing personal and professional development beyond sales skills

  • A mission you can believe in—and see the impact of daily

Ready to apply? 📬 We’re hiring right now, so don’t wait around.

👉 Send us:

  • Your CV

  • A short cover letter telling us what excites you about Famly and why you’d be a great fit OR if you don’t want to write - no problem, send us a video instead!


📋 The interview process

Here’s what to expect:

  • Video conversation with a member of the People & Talent team

  • Rational thinking test

  • Chat with Kat, Head of Key Account Management, UK&I/Nordics

  • Case study / Skills test with panel interview

  • A conversation with Matt, UK General Manager

  • Reference check

We try to move fast and keep it human throughout.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Famly is committed to diversity and inclusion. We’re building a team that represents a wide range of perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Whoever you are, we’d love to hear from you.
