jobs.title: Senior People Advisor - MATS
jobs.description:
Could you be the person we are looking for to join us as our new Senior People Advisor - MATS in Grangemouth? We want to hear from you.

About the Role

We are currently looking for an experienced and commercially minded Senior People Advisor to join us, acting as the dedicated HR lead for our Marine and Terminal Services (MATS) business area.

 

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced HR professional who enjoys working closely with operational leaders, managing complex employee relations matters, supporting organisational change and helping to build management capability.

 

As Senior People Advisor – MATS, you will be the primary HR contact for managers and employees across the division, providing expert advice and practical support across all aspects of the employee lifecycle.

 

You will lead on complex employee relations matters, support workforce planning and organisational change, build strong relationships with managers, and help develop leadership capability across the business.

 

This role offers the opportunity to make a real impact by influencing people decisions, supporting business performance and contributing to the continued development of GAC's people strategy.

What would your day at GAC look like?

  • Act as the dedicated HR lead for Marine & Terminal Services (MATS), building strong relationships with managers and employees and providing commercially focused HR support.

  • Partner with managers to support workforce planning, recruitment, succession planning and organisational change initiatives.

  • Support workforce transitions and TUPE related activity

  • Lead and manage employee relations matters including disciplinary, grievance, absence, capability and performance processes.

  • Build and maintain positive relationships with trade union representatives and support consultation and industrial relations activities.

  • Coach and develop managers to improve capability, consistency and confidence in managing people matters.

  • Support employee engagement, wellbeing and culture initiatives that contribute to retention and organisational performance.

  • Identify skills gaps and development needs within the business and support learning, leadership and career development initiatives.

  • Use people data and insights to identify trends, risks and opportunities and support effective decision-making.

  • Support the Head of People in delivering the HR strategy, driving continuous improvement and developing management capability across the business.

  • Mentor and support the development of junior members of the HR team, helping to build future capability within the function.


What are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who brings both strong employee relations expertise and the ability to build trusted relationships with operational managers.

You will ideally have:

  • CIPD Level 5 qualification (or equivalent experience).

  • Significant experience in a generalist HR or HR Advisory role.

  • Strong experience managing complex employee relations matters.

  • Experience working with trade unions

  • Sound knowledge of UK and Irish employment legislation.

  • Experience supporting managers in operational environments.

  • Experience in supporting TUPE transfers

  • Excellent communication, coaching and influencing skills.

  • The ability to work independently whilst collaborating effectively with colleagues and stakeholders.

  • A proactive, organised and commercially focused approach to HR.

What’s in it for you?

This is your chance to become part of the global GAC team which has been providing professional shipping, logistics and marine services since 1956. Everything we do is guided by the GAC Spirit, built on mutual loyalty between management and staff, and a belief in the value of our people as individuals - not just for the jobs they do.

With more than 7,500 colleagues in 300 strategically located offices in more than 50 countries around the world, we focus on quality, safety and sustainability with a human touch. Emphasising a long-term approach, innovation and ethics, our flexible and integrated portfolios are designed to work within and support our customers’ operations.

 

As our Senior People Advisor - MATS in Grangemouth you will have the opportunity to work as part of a team who apply the highest standard of customer services to everything we do and aim to be industry leaders within all the sectors we serve.

 

GAC UK gives you the opportunity to work for an employer who is committed to offering all our staff an enjoyable and rewarding career, with significant training and development prospects.

You will also enjoy:

  • 38 days’ annual leave per year (inclusive of bank holidays) plus a day off on your birthday

  • Access to Vitality at Work Scheme

  • Company pension

  • Life assurance

  • Eyecare scheme

  • Employee assistance programme

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity benefits

  • Retail discounts scheme


In 2021, we launched our ten-year sustainability programme – MARS30. We are committed to “growing long term customer relationships across multiple products, whilst significantly reducing our environmental impact, improving the well-being of our people, and influencing our stakeholders to do the same.” We will accomplish our by mission by completing objectives aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). 

  

At GAC UK, who you are is just as important as what you do. The GAC Spirit reflects our culture across the company, emphasising loyalty and understanding between management and staff. We recognise that people’s lives extend far beyond their jobs. By promoting a healthy combination of work and play we achieve a happier workforce, delivering service excellence. We have a team of Mental Health First Aiders across the UK and a Wellbeing Working Group who meet monthly and regularly launch new internal wellbeing initiatives. 

  

We’re passionate about diversity and inclusion, and we received Maritime UK Diversity in Maritime Charter Status in 2021, reflecting our commitment to taking real steps to improve diversity in our organisation. 

  

In January 2026, Campaign Against Living Miserably (CALM) became our official Charity of the Year. Throughout the year, we will be raising funds to support CALM’s life‑saving suicide prevention helpline. 

 

We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: UX Designer
jobs.description:
Of je jezelf nu UX Designer, Interaction Designer of Product Designer noemt: jij zorgt ervoor dat digitale producten en services logisch werken voor de mensen die ze gebruiken. Je beweegt makkelijk tussen strategie, gebruikersbehoeften, interactie en technologie. Van eerste inzicht en concept tot een uitgewerkt ontwerp dat daadwerkelijk gebouwd en gebruikt wordt.

Wat ga je doen als UX Designer bij Norday?

Bij Norday werken we aan complexe vraagstukken waarvoor niet altijd meteen duidelijk is wat de juiste oplossing is. Nieuwe technologie, veranderende verwachtingen en maatschappelijke ontwikkelingen vragen organisaties om richting te kiezen én die richting concreet te maken.

Als UX Designer help jij daarbij. Je vergroot de verbeeldingskracht van opdrachtgevers met scherpe inzichten en snelle prototypes. Je onderzoekt wat mensen nodig hebben, maakt complexe informatie begrijpelijk en vertaalt strategische keuzes naar digitale producten en services die in de praktijk werken. Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met strategen, service designers, visual designers, developers en projectmanagers.

Je werkt aan nieuwe digitale platforms, slimme tools, gepersonaliseerde ervaringen en nieuwe diensten. Soms ligt er al een duidelijke strategie, soms help je die samen met het team verder vormgeven. Je bent gedurende het hele proces betrokken: van het eerste vraagstuk en onderzoek tot concept, ontwerp, validatie en realisatie.

Wat je gaat doen:

  • Je duikt in de context van een vraagstuk en brengt gebruikers, behoeften, doelen en knelpunten in kaart;

  • Je vertaalt inzichten en strategie naar een concept, user flows, journeys en prototypes;

  • Je maakt complexe vraagstukken begrijpelijk en helpt klanten en teams om keuzes te maken;

  • Je faciliteert workshops en co-creatiesessies met klanten, gebruikers en collega’s;

  • Je bedenkt en test verschillende oplossingsrichtingen en gebruikt inzichten uit onderzoek om je ontwerp steeds verder aan te scherpen;

  • Je onderzoekt hoe AI kan bijdragen aan nieuwe diensten, betere ervaringen en waarde voor organisaties en de mensen die ze gebruiken;

Chez Novar, nous croyons que l’avenir de l’énergie est vert – et nous le concrétisons. Depuis notre création en 2014 aux Pays-Bas, nous sommes devenus un acteur majeur du développement et de l’exploitation de grandes installations d’énergies renouvelables. Werken bij een van de Top 3 spelers in Workforce management in Nederland en bijdragen aan snelle ontwikkeling in het buitenland? 
Bij Intus helpen wij onze klanten en hun medewerkers met slimmer plannen. Hierdoor dragen we bij aan het oplossen van één van de belangrijkste maatschappelijke uitdagingen: personeelskrapte. 

Onze producten brengen flexibiliteit en efficiëntie in het planningsproces en dat is fijn voor iedereen. Onze klanten kunnen onze medewerkers optimaal inzetten, terwijl we tegelijkertijd bijdragen aan meer werkgeluk en een gezonde werk-privé balans. Een win-win voor iedereen! 
 
Als projectmanager bij Intus speel je een cruciale rol in projecten bij onze diverse klanten in verschillende markten zoals zorg, overheid, industrie en logistiek. Je structureert en realiseert meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd van begin tot het eind. Dit kan gaan om het begeleiden van onze klanten bij het volledig implementeren van onze software InPlanning bij een nieuwe klant of het begeleiden van een complexe transformatie in het applicatielandschap bij een bestaande klant. Ook interne projecten kunnen onderdeel van de werkzaamheden zijn. Dankzij jouw vermogen om draagvlak te creëren en overzicht te behouden, help je klanten en zorg je voor een efficiënt verloop van de projecten.  
 
Je maakt deel uit van een team van projectmanagers en consultants die verantwoordelijk zijn voor alle projecten in Nederland. Als projectmanager ben jij tijdens een project hét aanspreekpunt voor de klant, met betrekking tot de voortgang, planning, kwaliteit, budget en uitvoering. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s (o.a. implementatie consultants en technisch consultants) om de projecten te realiseren, en daarnaast heb je ook regelmatig contact met je collega-projectmanagers, accountmanagers, technisch consultants en product owners. Kortom, een boeiende functie in een dynamische werkomgeving!  

 
Als projectmanager begeleidt je projecten van A tot Z wat betekent dat je de volgende verantwoordelijkheden hebt:  

  • Opstellen van een Plan van Aanpak en een implementatieagenda.  

  • Plannen van projectwerkzaamheden van consultants.  

  • Zorgdragen voor een goede samenwerking tussen alle interne en externe stakeholders van het project.

  • Bewaken van kaders waaronder projectdoelen, kwaliteit, budgetten en planningen.

About the Role

As a Senior Quality Engineer – Tellent Intelligence (AI), you'll own and grow the quality of the AI-powered experiences built by our Tellent Intelligence team alongside our existing QE team. You'll help shape how we test applications powered by large language models (LLMs) and AI agents, ensuring they are reliable, safe, and deliver high-quality experiences for our customers.

You'll expand our end-to-end test coverage in Playwright and help build robust approaches for validating AI-powered systems, where quality extends beyond functional correctness. This is a hands-on, collaborative role with genuine ownership, direct impact on product development, and the opportunity to shape how we test AI at Tellent.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • During your first 3 months: You'll get to know our Tellent Intelligence domain, engineering practices, AI-powered features, and quality standards. You'll learn our testing framework and development workflow while contributing to automated, exploratory, and AI-focused testing.

  • Within 6 months: You'll take ownership of quality across key AI-powered features, expand our Playwright test coverage, and work closely with engineers to validate AI behaviour, prompts, and model-driven functionality throughout development.

  • After 1 year: You'll be a trusted quality partner within the Tellent Intelligence team, driving improvements to our AI testing strategy, strengthening our automation framework, and helping shape how we build reliable, safe, and responsible AI experiences across Tellent.

What You'll Be Doing

jobs.title: Afstudeerstage IT
jobs.description:
Bij BAS, Europa’s grootste dealer in commerciële voertuigen én officieel Volvo en Renault Trucks dealer, krijg jij de kans om je te ontwikkelen binnen IT in de automotive branche. Ben jij op zoek naar een afstudeerstage vanaf januari/ februari 2027? Dan is dit iets voor jou!

BAS World groeit hard, en IT speelt daarin een sleutelrol. Binnen ons IT-team liggen verschillende afstudeeropdrachten klaar die elk een echt vraagstuk uit ons IT-landschap aanpakken. Elke opdracht heeft een eigen team dat je dagelijks begeleidt. Zo breng je je kennis in de praktijk en kickstart je samen met ons jouw carrière.

Mogelijke afstudeeropdrachten

1. Continuous performance & load testing (Engineering)
BAS World wil het aantal voertuigadvertenties online ongeveer 20 keer zo groot maken. In deze opdracht zorg je dat onze websites en systemen die groei aankunnen. Je onderzoekt welke (AI-gedreven) testtools passen bij onze stack. Daarna bouw je samen met het IDP-team een testsuite die dagelijks automatisch draait in de pipeline. Het resultaat is een productieklare testopzet en een advies over knelpunten en capaciteit.
Past bij: Software Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure.

2. Kleine AI-agents voor de business (Data / AI engineering)
In deze opdracht werk je als interne consultant binnen één afdeling, bijvoorbeeld Logistiek. Je spreekt gebruikers, brengt hun processen en knelpunten in kaart en bepaalt waar AI het meeste oplevert. Daarna bouw je één of meer kleine AI-agents op basis van de services en data die we al hebben. Je test ze en verbetert ze tot ze echt gebruikt worden in het dagelijkse werk.
Past bij: AI, Data Science, Business IT, Software Engineering, als je graag dicht op eindgebruikers werkt.

3. Realtime monitoring & bottleneck-analyse voor Thinkwise-applicaties (Engineering)
Verschillende kernapplicaties draaien op het low-code platform Thinkwise. Als gebruikers traagheid melden, kost het nu weken om de oorzaak te vinden. In deze opdracht bouw je monitoring die de performance over de hele stack realtime inzichtelijk maakt: van UI en applicatielaag tot database en netwerk. Die performance komt live op een scherm op de werkvloer van onze developers. Daarnaast ontwikkel je rapportage- en analysetooling waarmee developers bottlenecks precies kunnen aanwijzen en oplossen waar ze ontstaan. Zo vinden we problemen in uren in plaats van weken.
Past bij: Software Engineering, Infrastructure, DevOps, met interesse in performance en observability.

4. Problem management & ITSM-procesoptimalisatie (System & Application Management)
Onze Servicedesk en het S&AM-team krijgen veel meldingen binnen in Jira. Terugkerende problemen worden nog te weinig bij de bron opgelost. In deze opdracht breng je de ITSM-processen in kaart en leg je ze vast: processtromen, werkinstructies en rollen. Je toetst ze aan good practices zoals ITIL. Daarna ontwerp en implementeer je problem management als een vast proces, zodat terugkerende issues structureel verdwijnen.
Past bij: Business IT & Management, IT Service Management of verwant.

5. Datagedreven leadgeneratie met FleetCareXL & BAS World (Product)
Via FleetCareXL weten we precies hoe voertuigen onderhouden worden en wat dat kost. De verkoophistorie van BAS World vertelt ons veel over restwaardes. In deze opdracht combineer je deze twee databronnen in een proof of concept. Die berekent het ideale vervangmoment: wanneer onderhoudskosten gaan stijgen terwijl de restwaarde nog hoog is. Dat levert kostenbesparing op voor klanten en leads voor in- en verkoop. De opdracht kan ook andersom worden ingevuld. Dan onderzoek je hoe we FleetGuide selfservice of fullservice actief kunnen aanbieden aan klanten van BAS World.
Past bij: Data Science, Business Analytics, Software Engineering, met commerciële interesse.

Kortom: veel verantwoordelijkheid, veel samenwerking en een opdracht met echte impact.

Wij bieden jou

  • Een stagevergoeding van €500,- bruto per maand voor een fulltime stage én reiskostenvergoeding;

  • Een inhoudelijke en uitdagende afstudeeropdracht met zichtbare impact;

  • Dagelijkse begeleiding vanuit het team dat jouw opdracht host;

  • De mogelijkheid om onderdeel uit te maken van ons gedreven en enthousiaste IT-team;

  • Bij goede prestaties uitzicht op een vaste functie binnen BAS. Bij BAS zeggen we namelijk niet voor niets: “Bij BAS heb je geen baan maar een carrière!”;

  • Een vaste kruk bij de VrijMiBo en jouw naam op de gastenlijst voor onze bedrijfsuitjes en feestjes.

  • Je vindt het leuk om systemen en processen te verbeteren en oplossingen te bouwen die echt gebruikt worden;

We zijn actief sinds 1962. Sindsdien vestigden wij onze naam als een betrouwbare kracht in de Automotive. Als familiebedrijf zijn wij wereldwijd actief in kopen, onderhouden en verkopen van vrachtwagens, trekkers, trailers, bouwmachines, bedrijfswagens en landbouwmachines.

Als Product Owner Interne Automatisering & IT ben jij de onmisbare brug tussen de business en ons IT-landschap. In deze rol schakel je veel met interne stakeholders om processen echt te doorgronden. Vervolgens bepaal je hoe we onze tools, waaronder ons ERP-systeem Odoo en Camunda, optimaal kunnen inzetten. Omdat onze developer ook eigen projecten draait, is het fantastisch als jij zelf de taal van developers spreekt of zelfs je eigen Python-code kunt kloppen om snel iets te bouwen of testen.

  • Ophalen, analyseren en in kaart brengen van requirements bij diverse afdelingen en de MT-laag.

Bij Payter zijn we pioniers op het gebied van contactloze NFC- en cashless-technologie. Sinds 2007 maken we impact: we hebben het grootste Europese proefproject voor contactloze en mobiele betalingen gelanceerd, en sindsdien maken bedrijven over de hele wereld gebruik van onze oplossingen. We combineren innovatieve technologieën om veilige, duurzame en toekomstbestendige producten te ontwikkelen. In this role, you will be the driving force behind turning business needs into reality, starting by translating requirements into clear, functional designs. You will work closely with our hardware engineers and the broader technical team to build the platforms that power millions of transactions worldwide. This is an exceptional opportunity for a creative engineer who enjoys solving complex hardware-software integration challenges and wants to continuously develop their skills in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement high-quality embedded software and drivers for our cutting-edge payment terminals across various platforms.

  • Translate customer and business requirements into robust functional designs.

  • Set up and maintain the development and build environments, ensuring a smooth and efficient engineering workflow.

  • Evaluate and implement new development tooling to continuously improve our software engineering processes.

  • Collaborate closely with hardware developers to build scalable platforms, skillfully troubleshooting and resolving any technical issues that arise during integration.

  • Review and assess code, ensuring high quality standards are met, including evaluating deliverables from external subcontractors.

  • Continuously challenge yourself to acquire new knowledge, explore new technologies, and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.

About Payter

At Payter, we are innovators, pioneers, and leaders in the dynamic realm of unattended/self-service contactless and cashless payment technology in a wide range of markets such as Electrical Vehicle Charging, Transportation, Retail, Hospitality, Vending, Charity, Parking, and beyond. The adaptable Payter platform accommodates a diverse range of payment technologies (NFC, EMV, ApplePay, GooglePay, etc.), international banking processes, closed-loop payment and loyalty schemes, and telemetry.

Through continuous innovation and in-house development, we redefine how vendors connect with their customers, empowering them to boost revenue, enhance user experiences, and access real-time sales and performance data. We support a broad range of technologies, from Contact & Contactless EMV, Mifare, WiFi, 5G, Bluetooth, Touch Screens and more. Our state-of-the-art products have an extremely long service life, are of high quality, compliant with multiple international standards, boast great design, are user-friendly for all, multifunctional, and easy to integrate.

Examples of successful collaborations include:

  • EV Charging: Fastned, Shell, BP, Ionity, Alfen, EVBOX

  • Cashless Charity Donations: Hartstichting, WWF, Save the Children, Royal British Legion

  • Food & Drink Vending: Coca Cola, Lavazza, Starbucks, Jacobs Douwe Egberts, Costa, Heineken, Maas International, Franke, WMF, Wurlitzer, Selecta

  • Hospitality & Public Locations: Compass Group, Sodexo, Albron, TU Delft, TU Eindhoven

  • Gaming & Entertainment: Pinball, Slot Machines, Gaming Arcades, Efteling


  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field.

  • You have strong, proven knowledge of C and Android (this is required), while knowledge of Java is a strong plus.

  • You possess solid knowledge and hands-on experience developing embedded applications and drivers across various platforms.

  • You have extensive experience in platform development, working seamlessly alongside hardware engineers.

  • You are skilled in version control and release management practices.

  • You are highly independent, proactive, and consistently bring new, creative ideas to the table.

  • You are capable of conducting thorough code reviews, including those of third-party vendors or subcontractors.

  • You ideally have knowledge of GPRS, contactless applications, or mobile phone applications (this is a nice-to-have).

What We Offer

  • A challenging role with highly varied work in a successful, young, and fast-growing international organization.

  • 25 vacation days + 12 balance days per year for an optimal work-life balance.

  • Attractive pension scheme with just 3.6% employee contribution, we cover the rest.

  • Enjoy complimentary lunch at the office every day. 

  • A flexible hybrid working environment.

jobs.title: Junior Data Consultant
jobs.description:
Onze Missie

LOGEX is koploper in data-analyse in de gezondheidzorg. Wij zetten complexe zorgdata om in heldere inzichten waarmee zorgorganisaties grip krijgen op kosten, betere behandelresultaten realiseren en sturen op waardegedreven zorg. Onze oplossingen worden dagelijks gebruikt door meer dan 80 zorginstellingen, zowel publiek als privaat, en maken het verschil in de gezondheidszorg van morgen.

Jouw impact en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je verhoogt de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening door het valideren van financiële en zorginhoudelijke data. 

  • Je communiceert met klanten over hun data-aanlevering en de oplevering van LOGEX modellen. 

  • Je ontwikkelt je in de breedte en biedt ondersteuning aan meerdere teams en klanten als er vragen liggen met betrekking tot de kwaliteit van data. 

  • Je signaleert en realiseert kansen om interne operationele processen te verbeteren. 

  • Je draagt bij aan automatisering van onze operationele processen, mogelijk door inzet van AI.   

Team

Je maakt deel uit van het Financial Analytics Service team, dat momenteel bestaat uit 40 mensen met diverse achtergronden in de gezondheidszorg en data-analyse. Het team is verantwoordelijk voor het implementeren en onderhouden van onze oplossingen en benchmarks, die zowel medische specialisten als de planning- en controleteams in ziekenhuizen ondersteunen. Onze oplossingen helpen ziekenhuizen en medische specialisten bij maandelijkse rapportages over prognoses, het aanpakken van capaciteitsvraagstukken, portefeuillebeslissingen, het verbeteren van patiëntenzorgpaden en andere belangrijke strategische keuzes. 


Jouw profiel

  • Data-affiniteit: Je hebt interesse in data. Je werkt nauwkeurig, signaleert trends en spoort fouten of afwijkingen op.

  • Je bent resultaatgericht, werkt gestructureerd en hebt een pragmatische instelling. 

  • Bereidheid om te leren en aan te passen aan innovatieve technologieën, tools en processen. 

  • Een proactieve benadering om nieuwe taken op te pakken en kansen te zoeken om bij te dragen. 

  • Je krijgt energie van het verbeteren van  werkprocessen. 

  • Taalvaardigheden: Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. 

Wat wij bieden:

Bij LOGEX hebben we één superkracht: data-analyse. Wij kiezen ervoor deze superkracht in te zetten om de huidige problemen in de gezondheidszorg aan te pakken door gegevens te vertalen naar betere zorg. 

  • Een uitstekend beloningspakket (salaris, vakantiegeld, NS Business card, telefoon- en internetvergoeding)

  • Regelmatig borrels na het werk en nog veel meer evenementen

  • Mogelijkheid om een elektrische fiets te leasen via het fietsplan.

Klaar om mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van de zorg?

Je kunt solliciteren via onderstaande knop en je CV uploaden. Voor meer informatie, of als je vragen hebt, kun je contact opnemen met Wesley Schreuder op

jobs.title: Mobile Engineer - React Native (100% Remote) - Worldwide
jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job


We have launched Keet Mobile on iOS and Android, bringing our full P2P technology stack to everyone. Keet Mobile is not your average app: it’s heavy lifting is performed by a custom JS runtime specially designed for peer-to-peer usage (in fact, it reuses 100% of Keet Desktop’s code!). The UI logic, on the other hand, is 100% React Native, giving us flexibility and the ability to iterate quickly.

We believe this pattern opens the door to huge possibilities in the future, and we need your help getting there!

Responsibilities

In this role, you will develop and maintain Keet Mobile, our peer-to-peer chat and calling app for iOS and Android. Keet Mobile is built with React Native and Expo, and its P2P core runs on the device itself in a Bare worklet. You'll own features end to end, from UI/UX implementation to using the P2P core apis.

 You will:
 - Build and polish features across chat, voice and video calls, media sharing, device pairing and identity backup
 - Integrate native platform capabilities such as push notifications, camera, bio-metrics and background tasks on both iOS and Android
 - Profile and optimise performance on real devices, including startup time, long chats, media handling, battery and network use
 - Write unit and end-to-end tests, and help keep releases stable through CI and crash reporting
 - Work closely with the core P2P, design and product teams, and review code with a high bar for quality


  • Significant experience with React Native, Redux for state management and Redux-Saga

  • Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+.

  • Experienced with WebSockets, RESTful based APIs.

  • Knowledge in native languages (Swift/Kotlin) and familiarity with native build tools (Xcode/Android Studio) is advantageous.

  • Experience working with a remote team

  • Interested in modernizing and optimizing different mobile or web applications.

  • Bonus points if you have any built something amazing on any p2p frameworks .

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.title: Medior Web & Mobile Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
The mission
Help build fair, engaged and high-performing teams.
We believe everyone deserves a fair opportunity to develop and be rewarded for the value they bring. That’s why we build software that helps organizations set clear expectations, define what a role entails, assess performance fairly, support employee growth, and make compensation transparent and explainable. From clear roles to fair rewards, all within one continuous process. Will you join us in driving this change?

Please note: for this role, it’s important that you already live in the Netherlands and are able to work from our Utrecht office at least three days a week.

The opportunity
As our new Medior Web & Mobile Full Stack Developer, you’ll help build and improve our SaaS platform across all surfaces: mobile, web and backend. You’ll work on our React Native mobile app as we scale it into a fully independent experience for mobile-first markets. You’ll contribute just as actively to our web platform, from intuitive user interfaces in React to scalable APIs and backend services in Node.js.

Your average week in Utrecht:

  • Building and shipping new features in our React Native mobile app (around 50% of your time)

  • Building and shipping new features on our web platform, with React on the frontend and Node.js on the backend (around 50% of your time)

  • Shaping features together with product and design to improve the user experience

  • Working in structured weekly sprints with your team

  • Writing clean, scalable and maintainable code in TypeScript, React, React Native, Node.js and MongoDB

  • Building and improving performant, secure REST APIs

  • Contributing to technical discussions and architecture decisions, including our mobile strategy

  • Reviewing pull requests to keep quality high

  • Improving developer workflows, CI/CD and automated testing

  • Owning features from idea to deployment, across mobile and web

In short: your work directly makes our platform faster, smarter and more scalable, helping our customers grow and pushing Learned to the next level 🌱

The team
You’ll join a development team of 6 developers in Utrecht, working closely with 11 colleagues in Sri Lanka through a buddy system that keeps lines short. The team is led by Alex, our CTO. We’re an international company of 55 people (7+ nationalities) serving 350+ customers, increasingly at enterprise level. With the EU Pay Transparency Directive coming up, demand for our product is growing fast, and so is our roadmap.

Your growth

  • A clear growth path towards a Senior Full Stack Developer role

  • Learning every day from experienced, senior colleagues across mobile, web and backend

  • Hands-on experience building AI features into a product used by hundreds of companies

  • A personal development budget of €1,000 per year

  • An open feedback culture: we practice what we preach


The musts

  • You already live in the Netherlands and can work from our Utrecht office at least 3 days a week

  • Around 3+ years of experience as a Full Stack Developer

  • At least 1 year of experience building production apps in React Native

  • Solid experience with TypeScript, React and Node.js (or comparable stacks), including REST APIs

  • Experience building or integrating AI features in a product (e.g. LLM features, agents or retrieval)

  • You enjoy switching between mobile, frontend and backend, and owning features end-to-end

  • You communicate clearly and confidently in English

  • You’re proactive, take ownership and love learning together through feedback


The nice-to-haves

  • Experience with MongoDB or similar databases

  • Experience with CI/CD, automated testing and cloud infrastructure

  • Experience publishing apps to the App Store and Google Play

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally HR tech

The benefits

  • A salary between €4,000 and €5,500 gross per month (based on 40 hours, depending on experience), with room to grow

  • 25 vacation days (based on full-time)

  • A pension plan (10%, of which we pay 50%)

  • A personal development budget of €1,000 per year (based on full-time)

  • A MacBook Pro and everything you need to do your job well

  • Travel expense reimbursement via our mobility plan

  • A hybrid setup: at least 3 days at the office, flexible beyond that

  • The option to work remotely from abroad for up to 6 weeks per year

  • Daily healthy lunches, Friday drinks and monthly team activities 🎉

jobs.description:
🤖 Who we are

We’re building Mo — a health companion for everyone.

We’re a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise. We are building Mo, an intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care.

Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise - through chat, voice, or video. That’s what we are building 🤖.

We kicked off the project in 2023, and we have launched Mo to all our french members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe.

 

🚀 Why we need you

Mo’s scope is expanding fast: inside Alan (a new Clinic, new capabilities), across the countries we operate in, and at the interfaces with many other Alan experiences. To get this expansion right, and to keep ownership distributed within the team, we’re looking for a Product Builder to take on a real share of that complexity and ambiguity.

You’ll own end-to-end one slice of Mo’s product scope. Depending on your profile, it could be:

  • 🩺 Mo for reactive care. Build all the integrations between Mo, our Clinic and the healthcare system, and shape how our medical team interacts with members in and through Mo.

  • 🛡️ Mo for insurance. Make Mo the main interface between members and Alan, building on our Support AI agents, across channels and countries.

  • 🌍 Mo global. Adapt Mo to new countries and find the right operating model for each (medical reviews, safety, local features).

  • ➕ Mo as a platform. Make Mo the companion other teams build upon, so our domain experts can ship their own experiences through it.

🎯 Is it you we’re looking for?

We’re looking for Product Builders with around 5+ years of experience who want to build state-of-the-art AI products and apply them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare.

  • You’ll own a product area end-to-end: problem framing, vision, prioritisation, shipping, and measuring whether we actually help members get and stay better.

  • You’ll work daily with engineers, ML engineers, data, and doctors, at the frontier of LLMs and agentic systems, and see your work in production with real people.

  • You’ll navigate ambiguity and many stakeholders across Alan, and turn it into clear decisions and a focused roadmap.

  • You’ll be hands-on: prototyping, digging into data, reading conversations and evals, getting into the technical details with the team.

  • You’ll contribute to our product culture and help build the team (hiring, interview loops, etc.).

You would be a good fit in Mo if most of this sounds like you:

  • Experience building and shipping a live AI/LLM product

  • Very hands-on, comfortable with technical and data topics (SQL, prototyping, understanding how an LLM system behaves and fails)

  • Interest or experience in one or several medical or prevention themes

  • Product-minded and outcome-driven: you care about impact, not output

  • Self-directed, pragmatic, driven, hard working

  • Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!)

  • Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching

  • Fluent in English

  • Ex-engineers and ex-founders are typically a great fit in our team

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus

 

🤘 How we do it ?

We benefit from Alan’s platform, infrastructure, distribution, and health expertise — but operate with the speed and focus of a startup. If you’re curious about Alan’s broader vision, our Shareholder Letters are worth a read.

People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

 

How we work: our Leadership Principles

  • Mission is the Boss — We think long-term and are methodical optimists who take risks, seeking our mission's success above all else.

  • Distributed Ownership — Accountable enlightened despots: everyone owns their decisions and results.

  • Radical Transparency — All information is accessible and written-first, so everyone can make the best decisions asynchronously.

  • Always Growing — Direct, positive, and caring feedback, combined with self-growth ownership.

 

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.   • Go-to-Market strategy: You’ll work both on renewal (account management) and expansion strategy (business development). This will require you to adapt and innovate when it comes to distribution channels, sub-segments, and partners management.

  • P&L ownership & Resources allocation: You’ll own the return on investment of your segment and are in charge of building the case for internal resources allocation based on your P&L.

  • Product trade-off: You’ll work together with product teams in order for us to build the best product based on market insights.

jobs.title: Cleanroom Equipment Technician
jobs.description:
Over ons

De halfgeleiderindustrie vraagt om steeds krachtigere chips: meer bandbreedte, minder energieverbruik. Onze technologie levert precies dat. Wij verbinden chips met computernetwerken die enorme hoeveelheden data verwerken, met minimale vertraging. Samen veranderen we de manier waarop de wereld met elkaar verbonden is.

In Zoetermeer werkt ons grafeenteam aan de toekomst van de halfgeleiderindustrie, van onderzoek en ontwikkeling tot industrialisatie. Op het snijvlak van materiaalkunde en halfgeleidertechnologie ontwikkelt het team de processen om grafeen te produceren, te karakteriseren en te integreren. Die processen vormen de basis van onze geïntegreerde grafeenfotonica. Het team pioniert met nieuwe procestechnologie en schaalt die op tot productierijpe oplossingen. Zo wordt baanbrekend onderzoek omgezet in de bouwstenen van de chips van morgen.

De functie

Black Semiconductor is op zoek naar een gemotiveerde Technicus (m/v/x) om ons team op locatie in Zoetermeer, Nederland, te versterken.

Je speelt een cruciale rol bij het waarborgen van de betrouwbare werking van alle technische systemen die onze cleanroomomgeving ondersteunen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor onderhouds-, storingsanalyse- en reparatiewerkzaamheden aan voorzieningen zoals luchtbehandeling, gas-, water- en elektrische systemen. Deze functie is ideaal voor een praktisch ingestelde professional met technisch inzicht die graag zelfstandig werkt, technische uitdagingen oplost en nieuwe vaardigheden ontwikkelt in een sterk gecontroleerde en innovatieve omgeving.

Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

  • Zorgdragen voor een veilige en betrouwbare werking van cleanroomvoorzieningen, waaronder HVAC, toevoer- en afvoerlucht, gas-, water- en elektrische infrastructuur.

  • Uitvoeren van preventief onderhoud, storingsanalyse en reparaties aan productie en test apparatuur in de cleanroom en cleanroom systemen en inkomende nutsvoorzieningen.

  • Technische problemen diagnosticeren en oplossen om stilstand tot een minimum te beperken en de operationele continuïteit te waarborgen.

  • Onderhoudswerkzaamheden coördineren en uitvoeren, met inachtneming van normen en veiligheidsvoorschriften.

  • Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor technische uitdagingen en proactief mogelijkheden identificeren voor systeemverbeteringen en een hogere betrouwbaarheid.

Jouw kwalificaties

  • Afgeronde beroepsopleiding in een mechanische, technische of onderhoud gerelateerde richting (bijvoorbeeld automonteur, industrieel monteur, mechatronicatechnicus of vergelijkbaar).

  • Praktische ervaring met mechanische systemen en basiskennis van elektrische, pneumatische, gas- of utiliteitssystemen.

  • Sterke hands-on mentaliteit met het vertrouwen om onbekende technische uitdagingen aan te pakken en nieuwe technologieën te leren.

  • Vermogen om zelfstandig te werken, prioriteiten te stellen en volledige verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor toegewezen taken.

  • Probleemoplossende instelling, sterke vaardigheden in storingsanalyse en bereidheid om te werken in een cleanroomomgeving met strikte kwaliteits- en veiligheidsnormen.

  • Comfortabel met praktisch werk in cleanroom-, laboratorium- en facilitaire omgevingen, inclusief het gebruik van ladders om verhoogde gebieden te bereiken en het werken in beperkte ruimtes onder de cleanroom wanneer dat nodig is.

  • In staat om fysiek veeleisende onderhouds- en installatiewerkzaamheden veilig uit te voeren, zoals het vervangen van HEPA-filters, het bedienen van afsluiters, het positioneren van gascilinders en het verplaatsen van zware vacuümpompen. Voor zware lasten worden geschikte hulpmiddelen en ondersteuning van collega’s ingezet.

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in het Engels, bij voorkeur ook in het Nederlands om te kunnen communiceren met externe partijen, management en operators.

Ervaring in de halfgeleiderindustrie is niet vereist. Je ontvangt de nodige training en ondersteuning om de apparatuur te leren kennen en je technische vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen.

Hoe succes eruitziet

  • Volledige verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de cleanroominfrastructuur, en zorgen voor een betrouwbare werking van luchtbehandeling, gas-, water-, afzuig- en elektrische systemen met minimale stilstand.

  • Uitgroeien tot een vertrouwde technische expert binnen het team, door proactief problemen te signaleren, praktische oplossingen te implementeren en bij te dragen aan een veilige en efficiënte werkomgeving.

  • Sterke zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel tonen, door onderhouds- en reparatiewerkzaamheden zelfstandig te beheren en effectief prioriteiten te stellen in een dynamische omgeving.

  • Technische kennis en vaardigheden continu uitbreiden, snel nieuwe systemen en technologieën eigen maken en tegelijkertijd de hoge standaarden handhaven die vereist zijn binnen een cleanroomomgeving.

Onze werkcultuur

Mensen boven processen. Bij Black Semiconductor is flexibiliteit essentieel — wij zorgen ervoor dat werk zich aanpast aan het leven, en niet andersom. We stimuleren een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé, waarin carrières betekenisvol en verrijkend zijn. Onze processen zijn mensgericht, zodat jij je kunt richten op wat echt belangrijk is.

Laten we samen groeien. Jouw potentieel staat bij ons centraal. We bieden de autonomie om blijvende impact te maken en ondersteunen jouw groei met een cultuur van continu leren. We investeren in jouw professionele én persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Jouw gezondheid en toekomst zijn belangrijk. Jouw welzijn heeft de hoogste prioriteit. Daarom bieden wij een uitgebreid arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket met uitstekende verzekeringen, een pensioenregeling en virtuele aandelenopties voor jouw mentale, fysieke en financiële gezondheid. Jouw gemoedsrust staat bij ons centraal — nu én in de toekomst.

Wij leven openheid. Samenwerking en inclusiviteit vormen de hoekstenen van onze cultuur. Wij geloven in openheid en bouwen aan vertrouwen en respect. Individualiteit is onze gezamenlijke kracht, die innovatie stimuleert en ons vooruit helpt.

Wij verbinden chips – en mensen. Wij moedigen gekwalificeerde kandidaten van iedere achtergrond aan om te solliciteren. We creëren een inclusieve en ondersteunende werkomgeving waarin samenwerking, innovatie en groei centraal staan. Sluit je aan bij ons team en maak deel uit van een organisatie die een verschil maakt in de industrie.

Kun jij jezelf zien in deze functie en binnen ons bedrijf? Laten we kennismaken.

jobs.description:
Lieu :    Lyon                                                                           Date souhaitée de démarrage :  11/01/2027

Durée :  6 mois                                                             

« S’engager aux côtés d’HI, c’est agir pour venir en aide aux populations vulnérables que nous soutenons sur le terrain. Pour mener à bien cette mission, nous recherchons des étudiants motivés et prêts à mettre leur énergie au service d’une cause qui a du sens »

HI, Humanité & Inclusion est une organisation de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et des populations vulnérables, elle agit et témoigne, pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels, pour améliorer leurs conditions de vie et promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux.

Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap.  

Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux 1ers entretiens. 

 

Pour plus d’information sur l’association : www.hi.org

 

OBJECTIFS DU STAGE :

Le stage se fera au sein du service Sensibilisation - Communication de Handicap International, au siège de Lyon, dans le cadre des missions quotidiennes du service avec un large volet dédié à l’organisation des déploiements des Pyramides de chaussures. Être un soutien au service Sensibilisation - Communication dans leurs actions de sensibilisation et tout projet. 

Nous vous invitons à prendre connaissance des actions de sensibilisation et mobilisation en consultant : l’Espace du bénévolat et de la sensibilisation pour Handicap International.

La mission se déroulera du 11 janvier au 10 juillet 2027 (6 mois).

Les Pyramides de chaussures c’est le temps fort de sensibilisation et de mobilisation citoyenne pour Handicap International. Depuis plus de 30 ans, tous les citoyens, scolaires, salariés d’entreprises, sympathisants de Handicap International ou encore politiques sont invités à venir :

-          Lancer leurs chaussures pour témoigner de leur soutien aux causes portées par Handicap International, la chaussure symbole de l’engagement citoyen pour protéger les civils ;

-          S’informer à travers une exposition interactive, ludique et pédagogique sur Handicap International, ses champs d’intervention et ses combats ;

-          Rencontrer et échanger avec nos experts terrain

Depuis 2024 Handicap International a développé des Pyramides de chaussures dites « mobiles ». Le but ? Être présent toute l’année partout en France. Grâce à ce dispositif nous pouvons aller au plus proche de nos différentes cibles (scolaire, sympathisants, grand public, élus, médias) et leur proposer un temps de sensibilisation complet sur nos missions dans le monde. Pour en savoir plus sur les Pyramides : https://www.handicap-international.fr/fr/pyramides-de-chaussures

Le stage sera orienté autour de trois volets 

-          Appui à la prospection (recherche de structures hôtes ou de partenaires intéressés par des visites guidées)

-          Appui événementiel et logistique pour la préparation et le déroulement des déploiements.

jobs.title: Lead Architect - Digital Assets
jobs.description:
We are hiring on behalf of our client, an established, leading European regulated financial institution who is expanding its digital assets capabilities to build the next generation of financial market infrastructure. The organization is seeking a Lead Architect – Digital Assets to lead a zero-to-one build, bridging traditional capital markets with decentralised finance (DeFi).

This mandate involves architecting the core platform behind initial tokenised offerings across two major live initiatives currently in design:

  1. Tokenised Issuance, Trading, and Settlement Platform: Supporting equities, ETFs, and bonds with a 24/7 central limit order book, fractional trading, CCP-cleared trades, and end-of-day atomic DvP settlement on-chain.
  2. Tokenised Collateral-Management Platform: Designed for sovereign bonds to enable real-time repo, CCP-margin eligibility, and DeFi distribution of government securities through gated lending venues.

The architecture is built on core principles: the token serves as the direct financial instrument, one ISIN corresponds to one ledger, and tokenisation is driven directly by the CSD. The Lead Architect will turn these principles into a concrete, secure, resilient, and auditable infrastructure.

Requirements

  • Architecture & System Design: Own the end-to-end architecture for digital asset solutions, seamlessly integrating distributed ledger technology (DLT) with traditional market infrastructure (trading, clearing, settlement, custody, and CSD).
  • Cross-Chain & Network Topology: Design cross-chain topology combining permissioned chains for institutional and CCP operations (e.g., Hyperledger Besu, Canton Network) with public chains for DeFi distribution (Ethereum / L2).
  • On-Chain Compliance & Governance: Define regulatory compliance frameworks on-chain, utilizing regulated security-token standards (ERC-3643 / T-REX), KYC-whitelisted wallets, automated transfer restrictions, real-time AML screening (Chainalysis / Elliptic), and transaction reporting under MiFIR.
  • Custody & Key Management: Architect robust custody models around MPC solutions (e.g., Fireblocks, Taurus), incorporating hybrid frameworks to support bring-your-own-custody (BYOC) for institutional clients.
  • Security & Quality Standards: Establish code quality, code review, testing, and secure-by-design standards. Conduct threat modelling and lead security architecture prior to onboarding a dedicated security lead.
  • AI-Augmented Software Delivery: Define, implement, and govern an AI-assisted software delivery process using coding assistants, smart-contract scaffolding, and AI-generated test suites while enforcing strict risk and review guardrails.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product, legal, regulatory, clearing, CSD, and client working groups to maintain alignment with business objectives and regulatory frameworks (e.g., DLT Pilot Regime, MiFID II, MiCA).
  • Technical & Operational Leadership: Make key build/buy/partner evaluations on blockchain networks, custody, and audit solutions. Guide team evolution as products move from build to operational phases, maintaining hands-on involvement during critical incidents.

Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum 7 years of solution architecture experience, including at least 3 years dedicated to DLT or blockchain projects within high-value, 24/7 financial systems.
  • DLT & Distributed Systems Expertise: Deep fluency with EVM and permissioned chains (e.g., Canton, Hyperledger Besu).
  • Regulated Token Standards: Hands-on experience with regulated security token standards (ERC-3643 / T-REX or equivalent), on-chain compliance models, and security considerations around smart contracts and cross-chain bridges.
  • Capital Markets Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of capital markets settlement mechanisms (delivery-versus-payment, CSD operations, CCP/clearing) to effectively design system integrations.
  • AI Engineering Competency: Proven ability to evaluate, select, and integrate AI tooling into the development lifecycle (e.g., testing, scaffolding) while establishing strict guardrails around prompt hygiene, secret security, and license provenance. Ability to specify in-product AI capabilities (e.g., anomaly detection) with proper risk controls.
  • Leadership & Communication: Strong decision-making skills and composure under pressure. Excellent stakeholder management skills to bridge technical, business, legal, and regulatory domains.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. Professional certifications in cloud or blockchain technologies are advantageous.
  • Work Arrangement: Openness to work onsite in Paris, France, 4 days per week.

﻿

Benefits

  • Competitive annual salary (€100,000 – €120,000).
  • Key role within a high-visibility, zero-to-one build backed by an established, Tier-1 European financial institution.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge capital markets infrastructure and regulatory frameworks (MiCA, DLT Pilot Regime).

jobs.title: Software & Hardware Integration QA Engineer
jobs.description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 

Your role

Your Role

As a Software & Hardware Integration QA Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality and reliability of Quandela’s quantum computing systems.

Your main focus will be on validating the integration between software and physical hardware: ensuring that our software interfaces correctly control, communicate with, and monitor equipment such as photon sources, laser control systems and other optical and electronic components.

You will design and automate integration and end-to-end testing, while helping structure robust validation processes as Quandela moves from low-volume, highly complex systems toward more scalable and repeatable production.

Working closely with software, hardware, systems and industrialization teams, you will contribute to building the testing methods, tools, documentation and quality standards required for this next stage of growth.

Your Key Responsibilities 

  • Define QA plans, test strategies, acceptance criteria and validation procedures for software/hardware integrated systems.
  • Design and execute functional, integration, system, regression and robustness tests on real equipment.
  • Build automated software-to-hardware integration and end-to-end tests.
  • Validate complete workflows, from software interfaces and commands to their execution by physical equipment.
  • Test and troubleshoot communication between software and hardware through interfaces and protocols such as Ethernet and serial connections.
  • Develop and maintain automated tests and test tools using Python and testing frameworks such as Behave, with reporting tools such as Allure.
  • Integrate automated testing into continuous integration pipelines where relevant.
  • Reproduce, document and track defects through resolution, verify fixes and assess regression risks.
  • Maintain clear traceability between requirements, test cases, defects and test results.
  • Produce test reports, quality metrics and technical documentation to support validation and release decisions.
  • Help define and continuously improve industrial-grade validation processes, test procedures and quality practices.
  • Build reusable and scalable testing methods to support the progressive ramp-up of Quandela’s quantum computing systems.
  • Collaborate closely with software, hardware, systems and industrialization engineers to improve overall product quality.

Requirements

  • Around 5 years of experience in software QA, system validation, verification & validation, test engineering or a similar role.
  • Hands-on experience testing systems combining software and hardware.
  • Strong experience with test automation and scripting, ideally using Python.
  • Ability to understand, test and troubleshoot hardware/software interactions and communication protocols.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks and reporting tools; experience with Behave and/or Allure is a plus.
  • Experience working within structured software development and QA processes, including requirements traceability, documented testing, defect management and release validation.
  • An interest in building and improving testing processes, rather than only executing existing test plans.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Ability to produce clear and structured technical documentation.
  • Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams.
  • Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Experience in industrial environments such as robotics, embedded systems, scientific instrumentation, photonics, semiconductor equipment, medical devices, automotive, aerospace or other complex hardware/software systems would be particularly relevant.

Knowledge of quality standards such as IEC 61508 or ISO 9001 would be appreciated but is not mandatory.

An engineering degree or equivalent technical background is welcome, but we value relevant hands-on experience and demonstrated technical skills above all.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris, 1 to 2 days remotely)
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

jobs.title: Commercial Account Executive (Italy)
Product Safety & Certification Engineer - Fuel Cell Systems
jobs.description:
About EH Group Engineering

EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help achieve our vision of a decarbonised future we are seeking a Functional Safety Engineer to embed safety into our fuel cell systems, leading hazard analysis and safety engineering across hardware, software and controls to ensure our products are safe, compliant and certifiable.

This role requires full-time, on-site presence at our Nyon, Switzerland office. We're not able to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be prepared to relocate.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Own the functional safety lifecycle for fuel cell systems from concept to release

• Lead hazard and risk analyses (HARA, HAZOP, FMEA/FMEDA, FTA) and define safety goals

• Derive safety requirements and concepts and allocate them across hardware, software and controls

• Define/verify safety mechanisms, diagnostics and safe states with the controls and embedded teams

• Perform safety analyses and calculations (SIL/PL/ASIL determination, metrics, PFH/PFD)

• Compile safety cases, safety plans and supporting documentation for certification

• Interface with notified bodies, certification authorities and customers on safety topics

• Promote a strong safety culture and coach teams on functional safety practices

 

Skills and Experience Required:

• BSc/MSc in electrical, electronic, mechatronic, control or safety engineering is mandatory

• Minimum 3-5 years of functional safety experience in industrial, energy or hydrogen systems

• Working knowledge of safety standards (ex. IEC 61508, ISO 13849, ISO 26262 and/or IEC 62061)

• Hands-on experience with HARA, FMEA/FMEDA, FTA and safety requirements engineering

• Understanding of safety-related hardware, embedded software and control architectures

• Familiarity with hydrogen, high-voltage or pressure system safety is a strong plus

• Team player able to work autonomously with internal and external experts

• Excellent spoken and written English is mandatory; French/German is a plus

• Functional safety certification (e.g. TÜV FSEng) is a plus

 

Start date: Immediately

jobs.description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

We are expanding our commercial team and seeking a highly driven Director of Sales to lead the sales team to drive global revenue growth.

You will be responsible for leading the sales team’s success in achieving quarterly sales targets, collaborating with internal production stakeholders to meet customer product delivery commitments, and developing a high-performing sales organization.

What you'll be doing

Revenue Growth and Reporting

  • Drive Revenue Growth: Develop and execute comprehensive sales plans to meet and exceed revenue targets across a global customer base.

  • Sales Strategies: Work with the account managers, Product, and Business Development to drive sales growth across target regions and customers. Sales typically arise from new government-funded quantum compute platforms at research and academic institutions. Sales cycles can be lengthy (~12 months) and complex involving relationship building at the research labs as well as with ecosystem partners.

  • Sales Reporting: Oversee sales forecasting and report on metrics-driven performance against bookings and revenue goals.

Team Leadership

  • Build and Mentor: Train, mentor and recruit as required a high-performing sales team (3-5 FTE) in alignment with the QuantWare go-to-market strategic objectives.

  • FAE management: Establish FAE goals to ensure a positive customer experience with pre-sales and post-sales technical support

  • Partner with Business Development: Work closely with Business Development (BD) leadership to ensure Sales and BD are coordinated across Strategic Accounts and Government tenders.

Customer Relationship Management

Voice of the Customer: Ensure the sales team plays a strong role internally at QW as the voice of the customer, relaying customer feedback regarding delivery and product performance, as well as communicating new developments in customer requirements,

Contract Negotiation: Lead product pricing negotiations in coordination with the account management team and Product Management

Your Profile

  • Experience: 5+ years of sales experience in a technical or deep-tech industry.

  • Leadership: 3+ years of experience building, leading, and scaling high-performing sales teams.

  • Ecosystem Experience: Experience working with a diverse partner ecosystem, including Value-Added Resellers (VARs), systems integrators, distributors, and other strategic channel partners.

  • Technical Acumen: Ability to engage credibly with customers, partners, and the quantum computing ecosystem, while collaborating effectively with Product and Engineering leadership.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required. A degree in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is strongly preferred.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

jobs.title: Real-World Data Associate
jobs.description:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity: Real-World Data Associate

As a Real-World Data Associate at myTomorrows, you will support the design and execution of real-world data collection within Expanded Access Programs and other non-interventional studies. Working closely with the Real-World Data team, you will help keep communication with clients, physicians and site staff running smoothly, carry out data validation and quality-control tasks, and contribute to the documentation that supports consistent, high-quality RWD delivery. This is a great opportunity to build hands-on experience in real-world data within a purpose-driven, fast-growing company.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance to our office in Amsterdam.

What you’ll do in this role:

  • Support the design and day-to-day execution of RWD collection within Expanded Access Programs and other non-interventional studies.

  • Assist in maintaining communication with clients, physicians and site staff about data collection and data management.

  • Help monitor RWD collection and completion, flagging data discrepancies or missing data for follow-up.

  • Perform basic data validation, cleaning and quality-control tasks in electronic data capture systems.

  • Follow relevant regulatory requirements, internal procedures and ICH-GCP principles in all RWD study activities.

  • Support the preparation and maintenance of SOPs, templates and study documentation for RWD projects.

  • Share observations and ideas that could improve data collection, workflows and supporting tools.

  • Work under the guidance of more senior team members, collaborating closely with colleagues across the team and other relevant functions.

What you bring to the table:

  • A bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, biomedical sciences or another relevant scientific field.

  • 0–2 years of experience in Data Management or Clinical Research (e.g. an internship, traineeship or first role).

  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage priorities and follow through on commitments.

  • Familiarity with, or a strong interest in learning, electronic data capture systems and structured clinical or real-world data.

  • A basic understanding of ICH-GCP guidelines, or the motivation to develop it quickly.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Close attention to detail and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.

  • Eagerness to learn and the ability to contribute positively to a collaborative team environment.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

What Success looks like in the first 6 months:

  • Data completion and quality metrics for your assigned programs are consistently on target.

  • You’re contributing ideas and improvements to RWD processes and documentation, helping to raise the bar for data excellence at myTomorrows.

  • You’re recognized as a reliable partner by both internal teams and external collaborators, someone who ensures the integrity of real-world data to advance patient access

What we offer:

  • Serve a purposeful mission: helping patients gain access to potentially lifesaving treatments.

  • International work environment, scale-up energy and a flat organization.

  • Competitive salary, annual performance bonus and equity.

  • Great career-development opportunities in a growing company.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Mechanical Design Engineer to join our engineering team in Lausanne.   • Manufacturing & Supplier Integration: Work closely with suppliers to optimize designs for production methods such as CNC machining, stamping, pressing, forging, casting, and injection molding.

  • Product Data Management: Practical experience with configuration management practices, engineering change notices, and product data systems such as Siemens Teamcenter or similar PDM/PLM tools.

  • Manufacturing Tooling & Processes: Design experience across multiple manufacturing methods including machining, stamping, casting, forging, and molding.

  • Analysis & Verification: Ability to perform basic environmental, thermal, shock, and stress evaluations to qualify hardware designs against operational requirements.

  • Proactive Execution: Practical mindset with strong hands-on skills for prototype assembly, vendor management, and technical troubleshooting.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to establish core mechanical design capability and elevate drafting standards within a growing engineering team.

  • Direct hands-on work spanning initial CAD concepts through to manufacturing and field testing.

  • Broad exposure to complex electromechanical hardware, structural housings, and safety-critical mechanisms.
